views.name: v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
views.definition:
/*===============================================================
  View:   dbo.v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
  Purpose: One JSON document per timestamp with bid/ask per pair
           from dbo.forex_price_history where the price string is
           formatted  key , value , key , value …
===============================================================*/
CREATE   VIEW dbo.v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
AS
WITH raw AS (      -- 1) split + ordinal
        SELECT  f.current_datetime,
                s.value                           AS token,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY f.current_datetime
                    ORDER BY (SELECT 1)
                )                                 AS seq
        FROM  dbo.forex_price_history AS f
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(f.current_prices, ',') AS s
),
pairs AS (         -- 2) key token + next token (its numeric value)
        SELECT  r1.current_datetime,
                key_token = r1.token,
                val_token = r2.token
        FROM   raw r1
        LEFT  JOIN raw r2
               ON  r2.current_datetime = r1.current_datetime
               AND r2.seq              = r1.seq + 1
        WHERE  r1.seq % 2 = 1
),
parsed AS (        -- 3) product / side / numeric price
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                product = LEFT(key_token, CHARINDEX('_',key_token)-1),
                side    = SUBSTRING(key_token,
                                     CHARINDEX('_',key_token)+1,
                                     LEN(key_token)),
                price   = TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,6), val_token)
        FROM   pairs
        WHERE  CHARINDEX('_', key_token) > 0
          AND  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,6), val_token) IS NOT NULL
),
tidy AS (          -- 4) pivot bid & ask onto one line
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                product,
                bid = MAX(CASE WHEN side='bid' THEN price END),
                ask = MAX(CASE WHEN side='ask' THEN price END)
        FROM   parsed
        GROUP BY current_datetime, product
),
jfrag AS (         -- 5) one JSON fragment per product
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                json_piece =
          ',"' + product + '":{' +
              CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL
                   THEN '"bid":' + LTRIM(STR(bid,18,6)) END +
              CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL AND ask IS NOT NULL
                   THEN ',' END +
              CASE WHEN ask IS NOT NULL
                   THEN '"ask":' + LTRIM(STR(ask,18,6)) END +
          '}'
        FROM   tidy
        WHERE  bid IS NOT NULL OR ask IS NOT NULL
)
/* 6) assemble full JSON per timestamp */
SELECT
    '{ "current_datetime":"' +
        CONVERT(varchar(33), current_datetime, 127) + '"' +
        STUFF((
                SELECT jf.json_piece
                FROM   jfrag jf
                WHERE  jf.current_datetime = j.current_datetime
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
             ).value('.','nvarchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') +
    ' }' AS json_out
FROM jfrag j
GROUP BY current_datetime;

CREATE   VIEW dbo.v_leaderboard AS
WITH src AS (
  SELECT CAST(BulkColumn AS nvarchar(max)) AS jcol
  FROM OPENROWSET(
         BULK 'C:\Users\edebe\eds\Game_trader\leaderboard_data.json',
         SINGLE_CLOB
       ) AS s
)
SELECT
  JSON_VALUE(src.jcol,'$.last_updated') AS last_updated,
  lb.rank,
  lb.name,
  lb.net_equity,
  lb.open_buy_count,
  lb.open_buy_profit_count,
  lb.open_buy_profit_value,
  lb.open_buy_loss_count,
  lb.open_buy_loss_value,
  lb.open_buy_avg_age_seconds,
  lb.open_sell_count,
  lb.open_sell_profit_count,
  lb.open_sell_profit_value,
  lb.open_sell_loss_count,
  lb.open_sell_loss_value,
  lb.open_sell_avg_age_seconds,
  lb.closed_sum_buy_returns,
  lb.closed_sum_sell_returns
FROM src
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(src.jcol,'$.leaderboard')
WITH (
  rank                       int                 '$.rank',
  name                       nvarchar(100)       '$.name',
  net_equity                 decimal(19,9)       '$.net_equity',
  open_buy_count             int                 '$.open_trades_buy_stats.count',
  open_buy_profit_count      int                 '$.open_trades_buy_stats.profit_count',
  open_buy_profit_value      decimal(19,9)       '$.open_trades_buy_stats.profit_value',
  open_buy_loss_count        int                 '$.open_trades_buy_stats.loss_count',
  open_buy_loss_value        decimal(19,9)       '$.open_trades_buy_stats.loss_value',
  open_buy_avg_age_seconds   float               '$.open_trades_buy_stats.avg_age_seconds',
  open_sell_count            int                 '$.open_trades_sell_stats.count',
  open_sell_profit_count     int                 '$.open_trades_sell_stats.profit_count',
  open_sell_profit_value     decimal(19,9)       '$.open_trades_sell_stats.profit_value',
  open_sell_loss_count       int                 '$.open_trades_sell_stats.loss_count',
  open_sell_loss_value       decimal(19,9)       '$.open_trades_sell_stats.loss_value',
  open_sell_avg_age_seconds  float               '$.open_trades_sell_stats.avg_age_seconds',
  closed_sum_buy_returns     decimal(19,9)       '$.closed_trades_summary.sum_of_buy_returns',
  closed_sum_sell_returns    decimal(19,9)       '$.closed_trades_summary.sum_of_sell_returns'
) AS lb;

views.name: vw_000_forex_price_separated
views.definition: -- 2) Recreate it, using TRY_CONVERT + LTRIM/RTRIM create VIEW dbo.vw_000_forex_price_separated AS WITH SplitCTE AS ( SELECT p.current_datetime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.current_datetime ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) ) AS rn, x.i.value('.', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS token FROM dbo.forex_price AS p CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CAST( '' + REPLACE(p.current_prices, ',', '') + '' AS XML) AS xmlcol ) AS a CROSS APPLY a.xmlcol.nodes('/i') AS x(i) ), KeyValueCTE AS ( SELECT current_datetime, token AS [Key], LEAD(token) OVER ( PARTITION BY current_datetime ORDER BY rn ) AS [Value] FROM SplitCTE WHERE rn % 2 = 1 -- odd rows = the key names ) SELECT current_datetime, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='gbp_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS gbp_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='gbp_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS gbp_ask, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='eur_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS eur_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='eur_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS eur_ask, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='aud_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS aud_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='aud_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS aud_ask, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='nzd_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS nzd_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='nzd_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS nzd_ask, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='cad_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS cad_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='cad_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS cad_ask, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='chf_bid' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS chf_bid, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key]='chf_ask' THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,5), LTRIM(RTRIM([Value]))) END) AS chf_ask FROM KeyValueCTE GROUP BY current_datetime;

views.name: vw_000_forex_price_split
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_000_forex_price_latest
AS

WITH exploded AS
(
    SELECT
        vp.current_datetime,
        CAST(
            '<x>' + REPLACE(vp.current_prices, ',', '</x><x>') + '</x>'
            AS XML
        ) AS xml_prices
    FROM dbo.vw_000_forex_prices AS vp
),
toks AS
(
    SELECT
        current_datetime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY current_datetime
            ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)
        ) AS rn,
        x.value('.', 'nvarchar(100)') AS token
    FROM exploded
    CROSS APPLY xml_prices.nodes('/x') AS T(x)
),
paired AS
(
    SELECT
        current_datetime,
        key_name  = MAX(CASE WHEN rn % 2 = 1 THEN token END),
        key_value = MAX(CASE WHEN rn % 2 = 0 THEN TRY_CAST(token AS DECIMAL(18,6)) END)
    FROM toks
    GROUP BY current_datetime, (rn + 1) / 2
),
maxdt AS
(
    -- find the latest timestamp
    SELECT MAX(current_datetime) AS current_datetime
    FROM paired
),
latest AS
(
    -- grab every key/value row at that latest timestamp
    SELECT p.*
    FROM paired AS p
    JOIN maxdt    AS m
      ON p.current_datetime = m.current_datetime
)

SELECT
    l.current_datetime,

    gbp_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'gbp_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    gbp_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'gbp_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    eur_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'eur_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    eur_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'eur_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    aud_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'aud_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    aud_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'aud_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    nzd_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'nzd_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    nzd_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'nzd_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    cad_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'cad_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    cad_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'cad_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    chf_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'chf_bid'       THEN key_value END),
    chf_ask       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'chf_ask'       THEN key_value END),
    GBPEUR_c_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPEUR_c_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPEUR_c_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPEUR_c_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPEUR_s_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPEUR_s_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPEUR_s_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPEUR_s_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPAUD_c_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPAUD_c_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPAUD_c_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPAUD_c_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPAUD_s_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPAUD_s_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    GBPAUD_s_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'GBPAUD_s_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    EURAUD_c_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'EURAUD_c_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    EURAUD_c_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'EURAUD_c_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    EURAUD_s_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'EURAUD_s_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    EURAUD_s_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'EURAUD_s_ask'  THEN key_value END),
    CADCHF_c_bid  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'CADCHF_c_bid'  THEN key_value END),
    CADCHF_c_ask  = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'CADCHF_c_ask'  THEN key_value END)

FROM latest AS l
GROUP BY l.current_datetime;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_001_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp]
AS
SELECT TOP 3000 SnapshotID, SnapshotTimestamp, Product, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveSellClosed, BlockLatestPrice,[TotalBuyClosed],[TotalSellClosed],
CASE WHEN      (PositiveBuyOpen > PositiveSellOpen * 1.0) THEN 'buy' 
	 WHEN      (PositiveSellOpen > PositiveBuyOpen * 1.0) THEN 'sell' ELSE NULL END AS signal, 
				  
	LAG(CASE WHEN (PositiveBuyOpen > PositiveSellOpen * 1.0) THEN 'buy' 
					WHEN (PositiveSellOpen > PositiveBuyOpen * 1.0) THEN 'sell' ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp) AS previous_signal, 
					PositiveBuyClosedSum, PositiveSellClosedSum, PositiveBuyOpenSum, PositiveSellOpenSum
FROM     dbo.vw_001_product_signal_snapshot_with_signal
WHERE  Product = 'gbp' AND SnapshotTimestamp >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC;

views.name: vw_001_product_signal_snapshot_with_signal
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_001_product_signal_snapshot_with_signal]
AS
SELECT
    [SnapshotID],
    [SnapshotTimestamp],
    [Product],
    [BlockStartTime],
    [BlockEndTime],
    [BlockLatestPrice],
    [TotalBuyOpen],
    [PositiveBuyOpen],
    [PositiveValueBuyOpen],
    [AvgPriceBuyOpen],
    [TotalSellOpen],
    [PositiveSellOpen],
    [PositiveValueSellOpen],
    [AvgPriceSellOpen],
    [TotalBuyClosed],
    [PositiveBuyClosed],
    [PositiveValueBuyClosed],
    [AvgPriceBuyClosed],
    [TotalSellClosed],
    [PositiveSellClosed],
    [PositiveValueSellClosed],
    [AvgPriceSellClosed],
    -- Existing Cumulative Sums
    SUM([PositiveBuyClosed]) OVER (
         PARTITION BY Product, CAST([SnapshotTimestamp] AS date)
         ORDER BY [SnapshotTimestamp]
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS PositiveBuyClosedSum,
    SUM([PositiveSellClosed]) OVER (
         PARTITION BY Product, CAST([SnapshotTimestamp] AS date)
         ORDER BY [SnapshotTimestamp]
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS PositiveSellClosedSum,
    -- New Cumulative Sums for Positive...Open (as per your provided SELECT)
    SUM([PositiveBuyOpen]) OVER (
         PARTITION BY Product, CAST([SnapshotTimestamp] AS date)
         ORDER BY [SnapshotTimestamp]
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS PositiveBuyOpenSum,
    SUM([PositiveSellOpen]) OVER (
         PARTITION BY Product, CAST([SnapshotTimestamp] AS date)
         ORDER BY [SnapshotTimestamp]
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS PositiveSellOpenSum
FROM [dbo].[product_signal_snapshot];

views.name: vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint
views.definition:
/* allowed because of TOP (100) PERCENT*/
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint
AS
WITH src AS (SELECT SnapshotID, SnapshotTimestamp, Product, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, - (1 * PositiveSellOpen) AS PositiveSellOpen_val, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveSellClosed, BlockLatestPrice, signal, previous_signal, 
                                            TotalBuyClosed, TotalSellClosed, PositiveBuyClosedSum, PositiveSellClosedSum, PositiveBuyOpenSum, PositiveSellOpenSum
                          FROM      dbo.vw_001_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp)
    SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT SnapshotID, SnapshotTimestamp, Product, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveSellOpen_val, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveSellClosed, BlockLatestPrice, signal, previous_signal, 
                      CASE WHEN signal <> ISNULL(previous_signal, '') AND signal IS NOT NULL THEN signal ELSE NULL END AS tradepoint, PositiveBuyClosedSum, PositiveSellClosedSum, PositiveBuyOpenSum, PositiveSellOpenSum, 
                      CAST((CASE WHEN PositiveSellOpen = 0 THEN PositiveBuyOpen ELSE PositiveBuyOpen / NULLIF (PositiveSellOpen, 0) END) 
                      + (CASE WHEN PositiveBuyOpen = 0 THEN PositiveSellOpen_val ELSE PositiveSellOpen_val / NULLIF (PositiveBuyOpen, 0) END) AS INT) AS BuySellIndex, TotalBuyClosed, TotalSellClosed
    FROM     src AS src_1
    WHERE  (BlockLatestPrice <> - 1)
    ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC

views.name: vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal]
AS
SELECT 
    SnapshotID,
    SnapshotTimestamp,
    Product,
    PositiveBuyOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen_val,
    PositiveBuyClosed,
    PositiveSellClosed,
    BlockLatestPrice,
	[TotalBuyClosed],[TotalSellClosed],
    PositiveBuyClosedSum,
    PositiveSellClosedSum,
    PositiveBuyOpenSum,
    PositiveSellOpenSum,
    /* new ratio columns: cast to int and handle division by zero */
    CAST(PositiveBuyOpenSum / NULLIF(PositiveSellOpenSum, 0) AS INT) AS PositiveSumBuyOverSell,
    CAST(PositiveSellOpenSum / NULLIF(PositiveBuyOpenSum, 0) AS INT) AS PositiveSumSellOverBuy,
    BuySellIndex,
    /* enhanced tradezone column with NoBuyTrade and NoSellTrade for intermediate BSI ranges */
    CASE 
        -- signal 'buy' when BSI exceeds dynamic max or strong buy imbalance
        WHEN BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
             OR (PositiveBuyOpen > PositiveSellOpen 
                 AND PositiveSellOpen < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_tradezone_limit')) 
        THEN 'buy'
        -- signal 'NoBuyTrade' when BSI is positive but below buy threshold
        WHEN BuySellIndex > 0 
             AND BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
        THEN 'NoBuyTrade'
        -- signal 'NoSellTrade' when BSI is negative but above sell threshold
        WHEN BuySellIndex < 0 
             AND BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
        THEN 'NoSellTrade'
        -- signal 'sell' when BSI below dynamic min or strong sell imbalance
        WHEN BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
             OR (PositiveSellOpen > PositiveBuyOpen 
                 AND PositiveBuyOpen < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_tradezone_limit')) 
        THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS tradezone,
    /* existing tradepoint logic */
    CASE 
        -- signal a “buy” when BSI just crossed above the dynamic max limit
        WHEN BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
             AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) 
                 <= (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
        THEN 'buy'
        -- signal a “sell” when BSI just crossed below the dynamic min limit
        WHEN BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
             AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) 
                 >= (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
        THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS tradepoint
FROM dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint;

views.name: vw_101_PositiveOpen_WithRunningTotals
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_101_PositiveOpen_WithRunningTotals]
AS
/* get the reference datetime */
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS DATETIME) AS RefDate
    FROM   dbo.config
    WHERE  config_name = 'gbp_reference_datetime'
),

/* pull in raw data + running totals + BSI */
base AS (
    SELECT
        pss.SnapshotTimestamp,
        pss.SnapshotID,                 -- for LAG() in tradepoint
        pss.Product,
        pss.BlockLatestPrice,
        pss.PositiveBuyOpen,
        pss.PositiveSellOpen,

        /* running totals */
        SUM(pss.PositiveBuyOpen)  OVER (PARTITION BY pss.Product
                                        ORDER BY pss.SnapshotTimestamp
                                        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
            AS PositiveBuyOpenSum,

        SUM(pss.PositiveSellOpen) OVER (PARTITION BY pss.Product
                                        ORDER BY pss.SnapshotTimestamp
                                        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
            AS PositiveSellOpenSum,

        /* original BSI */
        x.BuySellIndex
    FROM dbo.product_signal_snapshot AS pss
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    CROSS APPLY (
        SELECT CAST(
                 (CASE WHEN pss.PositiveSellOpen = 0
                       THEN pss.PositiveBuyOpen
                       ELSE pss.PositiveBuyOpen / NULLIF(pss.PositiveSellOpen,0)
                  END)
               + (CASE WHEN pss.PositiveBuyOpen = 0
                       THEN pss.PositiveSellOpen
                       ELSE pss.PositiveSellOpen / NULLIF(pss.PositiveBuyOpen,0)
                  END)
               AS INT) AS BuySellIndex
    ) AS x
    WHERE pss.SnapshotTimestamp > cfg.RefDate
)

SELECT
    SnapshotTimestamp,
    Product,
    BlockLatestPrice,
    PositiveBuyOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen,
    PositiveBuyOpenSum,
    PositiveSellOpenSum,
    BuySellIndex,

    /* □ UPDATED tradezone: needs ≥100 gap □ */
    CASE
        WHEN PositiveBuyOpenSum - PositiveSellOpenSum >= 100 THEN 'buy'
        WHEN PositiveSellOpenSum - PositiveBuyOpenSum >= 100 THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS tradezone,

    /* □ unchanged tradepoint crossing logic □ */
    CASE
        WHEN BuySellIndex >  100
          AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER 
              (PARTITION BY Product
               ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) <= 100
        THEN 'buy'

        WHEN BuySellIndex < -100
          AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER 
              (PARTITION BY Product
               ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) >= -100
        THEN 'sell'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS tradepoint

FROM base;

AS
SELECT TOP (1000) current_datetime, product, buy_count, sell_count, buy_count - sell_count AS buy_sell_diff, bid, ask
FROM     dbo.ProductTradeSummary
WHERE  (current_datetime > CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_103_TradeSnapshotLog
AS
SELECT TOP (1000) SnapshotTimestamp, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, BlockLatestPrice, BuySellIndex, tradezone, buy_sell_diff, CASE WHEN buy_sell_diff > 0 AND tradezone > 'buy' THEN 'buy' WHEN buy_sell_diff < 0 AND 
                  tradezone = 'sell' THEN 'sell' ELSE NULL END AS tradezone2
FROM     dbo.TradeSnapshotLog
WHERE  (SnapshotTimestamp >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC

views.name: vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_10min
views.definition:
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------
   View:  dbo.vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_10min
   Purpose:  Ten-minute aggregation for GBP, plus %
-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_10min]
AS
/*===============================================================
  1)  Collapse buy/sell rows for the current day, age_label = 10
================================================================*/
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS Buy_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS Buy_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS Buy_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS Buy_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        END) AS Sell_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open END) AS Sell_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        END) AS Sell_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      END) AS Sell_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(current_prices) AS Current_Price
    FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
    WHERE age_label = 10                      -- was 60
      AND product     = 'gbp'                 -- hard-wired for now
      AND CurrentDateTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)   -- “today”
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
),
/*===============================================================
  2)  Derived columns that rely only on BaseData
================================================================*/
Calc AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        Buy_Opened,
        Buy_Positive_Open,
        Buy_Closed,
        Buy_Positive_Closed,
        Sell_Opened,
        Sell_Positive_Open,
        Sell_Closed,
        Sell_Positive_Closed,
        Current_Price,

        /* difference between sides */
        Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened AS open_diff,

        /* % positive opens – protect against div/0 */
        CASE WHEN Buy_Opened  > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Buy_Positive_Open  / Buy_Opened
        END AS buy_percent,

        CASE WHEN Sell_Opened > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Sell_Positive_Open / Sell_Opened
        END AS sell_percent
    FROM BaseData
)
/*===============================================================
  3)  Final projection + running counters
================================================================*/
SELECT
    CurrentDateTime,
    product,

    Buy_Opened,
    Buy_Positive_Open,
    Buy_Closed,
    Buy_Positive_Closed,
    Sell_Opened,
    Sell_Positive_Open,
    Sell_Closed,
    Sell_Positive_Closed,
    Current_Price,

    open_diff,
    buy_percent,
    sell_percent,

    /* cumulative tallies for open-diff */
    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS positive_open_diff_count,

    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS negative_open_diff_count,

    /* cumulative tallies for buy/sell % thresholds */
    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_50,


    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_50,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_90,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_90
FROM Calc;

views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_120min]
AS
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS buy_open_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS buy_open_positive_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS buy_closed_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS buy_closed_positive_trades,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        END) AS sell_open_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open END) AS sell_open_positive_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        END) AS sell_closed_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      END) AS sell_closed_positive_trades,

        /* Split current_prices 'bid / ask' into numeric columns */
        MAX(
            CASE 
                WHEN CHARINDEX('/', REPLACE(current_prices,' ','')) > 0
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6),
                     LEFT(REPLACE(current_prices,' ',''), CHARINDEX('/', REPLACE(current_prices,' ','')) - 1))
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS Current_Bid,
        MAX(
            CASE 
                WHEN CHARINDEX('/', REPLACE(current_prices,' ','')) > 0
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6),
                     SUBSTRING(REPLACE(current_prices,' ',''), CHARINDEX('/', REPLACE(current_prices,' ','')) + 1, 4000))
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS Current_Ask
    FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
    WHERE age_label = 120
      AND product     = 'gbp'
      AND CurrentDateTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
),
Calc AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        buy_open_total_trades,
        buy_open_positive_trades,
        buy_closed_total_trades,
        buy_closed_positive_trades,
        sell_open_total_trades,
        sell_open_positive_trades,
        sell_closed_total_trades,
        sell_closed_positive_trades,

        Current_Bid,
        Current_Ask,

        buy_open_total_trades - sell_open_total_trades AS open_diff,

        CASE WHEN buy_open_total_trades  > 0
             THEN 100.0 * buy_open_positive_trades  / buy_open_total_trades END AS buy_percent,

        CASE WHEN sell_open_total_trades > 0
             THEN 100.0 * sell_open_positive_trades / sell_open_total_trades END AS sell_percent
    FROM BaseData
)
SELECT
    CurrentDateTime,
    product,

    buy_open_total_trades,
    buy_open_positive_trades,
    buy_closed_total_trades,
    buy_closed_positive_trades,
    sell_open_total_trades,
    sell_open_positive_trades,
    sell_closed_total_trades,
    sell_closed_positive_trades,

    Current_Bid,
    Current_Ask,

    open_diff,
    buy_percent,
    sell_percent,
    buy_percent - sell_percent AS percent_diff
FROM Calc;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------
   View:  dbo.vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_120min
   Purpose: 120-minute aggregation for GBP, plus % metrics
-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_120min_restricted]
AS
/*===============================================================
  1)  Collapse buy/sell rows for the current day (age_label = 120)
================================================================*/
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS buy_open_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS buy_open_positive_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS buy_closed_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS buy_closed_positive_trades,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        END) AS sell_open_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open END) AS sell_open_positive_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        END) AS sell_closed_total_trades,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      END) AS sell_closed_positive_trades,

        MAX(current_prices) AS Current_Price
    FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
    WHERE age_label = 120
      AND product     = 'gbp'
      AND CurrentDateTime >=(select config_value from config where config_name='strategy11')     -- “today”
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
),
/*===============================================================
  2)  Derived columns that rely only on BaseData
================================================================*/
Calc AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        buy_open_total_trades,
        buy_open_positive_trades,
        buy_closed_total_trades,
        buy_closed_positive_trades,
        sell_open_total_trades,
        sell_open_positive_trades,
        sell_closed_total_trades,
       sell_closed_positive_trades,
        Current_Price,

        /* difference between sides */
        buy_open_total_trades - sell_open_total_trades AS open_diff,

        /* % positive opens – protect against div/0 */
        CASE WHEN buy_open_total_trades  > 0
             THEN 100.0 * buy_open_positive_trades  / buy_open_total_trades
        END AS buy_percent,

        CASE WHEN sell_open_total_trades > 0
             THEN 100.0 * sell_open_positive_trades / sell_open_total_trades
        END AS sell_percent
    FROM BaseData
)
/*===============================================================
  3)  Final projection + running counters
================================================================*/
SELECT
    CurrentDateTime,
    product,

        buy_open_total_trades,
        buy_open_positive_trades,
       -- buy_closed_total_trades,
       -- buy_closed_positive_trades,
        sell_open_total_trades,
        sell_open_positive_trades,
        --sell_closed_total_trades,
        --sell_closed_positive_trades,
    Current_Price,

    open_diff,

    /* ―― NEW COLUMN ――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――― */
    open_diff
      - FIRST_VALUE(open_diff) OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime)
        AS open_diff_change

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_30min]
AS
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT 
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        ELSE NULL END) AS Buy_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open ELSE NULL END) AS Buy_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        ELSE NULL END) AS Buy_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      ELSE NULL END) AS Buy_Positive_closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        ELSE NULL END) AS Sell_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open ELSE NULL END) AS Sell_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        ELSE NULL END) AS Sell_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      ELSE NULL END) AS Sell_Positive_closed,
        MAX(current_prices) AS current_prices
    FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog
    WHERE (age_label = 30) AND (CurrentDateTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
    HAVING (product = 'gbp')
)
SELECT
    *,
    (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) AS open_diff,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS positive_open_diff_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS negative_open_diff_count
FROM BaseData
-- ORDER BY CurrentDateTime DESC  -- REMOVE THIS LINE!

views.name: vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min
views.definition:
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------
   View:  dbo.vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min
   Purpose:  One-hour aggregation for GBP, plus %
-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min]
AS
/*===============================================================
  1)  Collapse buy/sell rows for the current day, age_label = 60
================================================================*/
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS Buy_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS Buy_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS Buy_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS Buy_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        END) AS Sell_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open END) AS Sell_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        END) AS Sell_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      END) AS Sell_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(current_prices) AS Current_Price
    FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
    WHERE age_label = 60
      AND product     = 'gbp'                          -- hard-wired for now
      AND CurrentDateTime >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)   -- “today”
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
),
/*===============================================================
  2)  Derived columns that rely only on BaseData
================================================================*/
Calc AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        Buy_Opened,
        Buy_Positive_Open,
        Buy_Closed,
        Buy_Positive_Closed,
        Sell_Opened,
        Sell_Positive_Open,
        Sell_Closed,
        Sell_Positive_Closed,
        Current_Price,

        /* difference between sides */
        Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened AS open_diff,

        /* % positive opens – protect against div/0 */
        CASE WHEN Buy_Opened  > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Buy_Positive_Open  / Buy_Opened
        END AS buy_percent,

        CASE WHEN Sell_Opened > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Sell_Positive_Open / Sell_Opened
        END AS sell_percent
    FROM BaseData
)
/*===============================================================
  3)  Final projection + running counters
================================================================*/
SELECT
    CurrentDateTime,
    product,

    Buy_Opened,
    Buy_Positive_Open,
    Buy_Closed,
    Buy_Positive_Closed,
    Sell_Opened,
    Sell_Positive_Open,
    Sell_Closed,
    Sell_Positive_Closed,
    Current_Price,

    open_diff,
    buy_percent,
    sell_percent,

    /* cumulative tallies for open-diff */
    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS positive_open_diff_count,

    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS negative_open_diff_count,

    /* cumulative tallies for buy/sell % thresholds */
    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_90,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_90
FROM Calc;

-- Modified view to include FX midprice + target_profit/target_loss aggregates
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_106_ModelPerformance_actual] AS
SELECT 
    c.model, 
    c.signal, 
    c.product,
    CAST(c.last_update AS DATE) AS last_update,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trade_count, 
    SUM(c.actual_net) AS total_return, 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS profitable_percent,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN c.entry_price END)  AS avg_profitable_entry_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN c.latest_price END) AS avg_profitable_latest_price,

    -- NEW: aggregate targets (group-safe)
    AVG(c.target_profit) AS avg_target_profit,
    AVG(c.target_loss)   AS avg_target_loss,

    -- FX mid
    (fq.bid + fq.ask) / 2.0 AS fx_midprice
FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
JOIN dbo.fx_quotes AS fq
    ON c.product = fq.code
GROUP BY 
    c.model, 
    c.signal, 
    c.product, 
    CAST(c.last_update AS DATE),
    fq.bid,
    fq.ask
HAVING 
    SUM(c.actual_net) >= 0
    AND ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) = 100;

                  AS avg_profitable_latest_price, (fq.bid + fq.ask) / 2.0 AS fx_midprice

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_106_ModelPerformance_alt_2hr]
AS
WITH trades AS (
    SELECT
        model,
        signal,
        product,
        CAST(last_update AS date) AS trade_date,
        entry_price,
        latest_price,
        alt_net_return
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
    WHERE created >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETDATE())
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        model,
        signal,
        product,
        trade_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_trade_count,
        SUM(alt_net_return) AS total_return,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS profitable_percent,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.alt_net_return > 0 THEN t.entry_price END)  AS avg_profitable_entry_price,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.alt_net_return > 0 THEN t.latest_price END) AS avg_profitable_latest_price
    FROM trades AS t
    GROUP BY model, signal, product, trade_date
    HAVING SUM(alt_net_return) >= 0
       AND (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)) = 100
)
SELECT
    a.model,
    a.signal,
    a.product,
    a.trade_date,
    a.total_trade_count,
    a.total_return,
    a.profitable_percent,
    a.avg_profitable_entry_price,
    a.avg_profitable_latest_price,
    (q.bid + q.ask) / 2.0 AS fx_midprice,
    CASE
        WHEN a.signal = N'buy'
             AND (q.bid + q.ask) / 2.0 >= a.avg_profitable_entry_price
            THEN N'buy'
        WHEN a.signal = N'sell'
             AND (q.bid + q.ask) / 2.0 <= a.avg_profitable_entry_price
            THEN N'sell'
        ELSE N'none'
    END AS exe_signal
FROM agg AS a
INNER JOIN dbo.fx_quotes AS q
    ON q.code = a.product

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_109_rt_trades_open_closed]
AS
WITH OpenLatest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT t.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY t.trade_guid
                   ORDER BY t.trade_time DESC, t.trade_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.tbl_rt_trades AS t
        WHERE t.trade_status = 'open'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
ClosedLatest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT t.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY t.trade_guid
                   ORDER BY t.trade_time DESC, t.trade_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.tbl_rt_trades AS t
        WHERE t.trade_status = 'closed'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(o.trade_reason, c.trade_reason) AS trade_reason,
    COALESCE(o.trade_guid, c.trade_guid)     AS trade_guid,
    COALESCE(o.product, c.product)           AS product,
    COALESCE(o.product_type, c.product_type) AS product_type,
    COALESCE(o.flip_trade, c.flip_trade)     AS flip_trade,

    -- open
    o.trade_id                               AS open_trade_id,
    FORMAT(o.trade_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS open_time,
    o.signal                                 AS open_signal,
    o.trade_details                          AS open_details,
    o.execution_status                       AS open_execution_status,

    -- closed
    c.trade_id                               AS close_trade_id,
    FORMAT(c.trade_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS close_time,
    c.signal                                 AS close_signal,
    c.trade_details                          AS close_details,
    c.execution_status                       AS close_execution_status,

    CASE WHEN o.trade_time IS NOT NULL AND c.trade_time IS NOT NULL
         THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, o.trade_time, c.trade_time)
    END AS hold_seconds
FROM OpenLatest o
LEFT JOIN ClosedLatest c
  ON c.trade_guid = o.trade_guid
WHERE CAST(o.trade_time AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

views.name: vw_110_Xhr_Returns_Summary
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_110_Xhr_Returns_Summary
AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT
        cv = LOWER(CAST(config_value AS NVARCHAR(50)))
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = N'scan_return_type'
),
period AS (
    SELECT
        period_minutes = TRY_CAST(config_value AS INT)
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = N'scan_analysis_period'
),
recent AS (
    SELECT
        c.product,
        c.signal,
        return_value =
            CASE
                WHEN (SELECT cv FROM cfg) IN (N'1', N'net_return')      THEN c.net_return
                WHEN (SELECT cv FROM cfg) IN (N'2', N'alt_net_return')  THEN c.alt_net_return
                ELSE c.net_return
            END
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE c.created >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -p.period_minutes, GETDATE())
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT product, signal, return_value
    FROM recent
    WHERE return_value > 0
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product, signal, SUM(return_value) AS sum_return
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY product, signal
)
SELECT
    product,
    buy_sum  = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0),
    sell_sum = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0),
    suggested_signal =
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
               > COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
                THEN N'buy'
            WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
               > COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
                THEN N'sell'
            ELSE N'neutral'
        END
FROM agg
GROUP BY product;

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_111_min_closed_alt_returns_minutely]
AS
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(minute, DATEDIFF(minute, 0, c.last_update), 0) AS last_update_minute,
        CAST(COALESCE(c.alt_net_return, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,8))   AS alt_net_return,
        LOWER(COALESCE(c.signal, ''))                          AS signal
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.last_update_minute,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('buy','b')  THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS buy_alt_net_return,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS sell_alt_net_return
    FROM Base b
    GROUP BY b.last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    a.last_update_minute AS last_update,
    a.buy_alt_net_return,
    a.sell_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.buy_alt_net_return)  OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS buy_alt_net_sum,
    SUM(a.sell_alt_net_return) OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS sell_alt_net_sum
FROM Agg a;

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_111_min_open_alt_returns_minutely]
AS
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(minute, DATEDIFF(minute, 0, o.last_update), 0) AS last_update_minute,
        CAST(COALESCE(o.alt_net_return, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,8))   AS alt_net_return,
        LOWER(COALESCE(o.signal, ''))                          AS signal,
        TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,8), o.entry_price)              AS entry_price
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open AS o
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.last_update_minute,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('buy','b')  THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS buy_alt_net_return,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS sell_alt_net_return,
        AVG(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('buy','b')  THEN b.entry_price END)            AS buy_entry_price,
        AVG(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.entry_price END)            AS sell_entry_price
    FROM Base b
    GROUP BY b.last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    a.last_update_minute AS last_update,
    a.buy_alt_net_return,
    a.sell_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.buy_alt_net_return)  OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_buy_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.sell_alt_net_return) OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_sell_alt_net_return,
    a.buy_entry_price,
    a.sell_entry_price
FROM Agg a;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_113_Combined_trades_all]
AS
WITH base_o AS (
    SELECT
        o.guid,
        o.model,
        o.signal,
        o.last_update,
        o.net_return,
        o.alt_net_return
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open AS o
),

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_118_PositiveTradeCounts_ByMinute]
AS
WITH MinuteBuckets AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        trade_status,
        DATEADD(MINUTE, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, last_update), 0) AS last_update_minute,
        signal,
        net_return,
        latest_price,
        last_update,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, trade_status,
                         DATEADD(MINUTE, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, last_update), 0)
            ORDER BY last_update DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.vw_114_Combined_trades_all_flex WITH (NOLOCK)
),
MinuteCounts AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        trade_status,
        last_update_minute,
        SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buy_count_pos,
        SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sell_count_pos,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN latest_price END) AS latest_price
    FROM MinuteBuckets
    GROUP BY
        product,
        trade_status,
        last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    product,
    trade_status,
    last_update_minute,
    buy_count_pos,
    sell_count_pos,
    SUM(buy_count_pos) OVER (PARTITION BY product, trade_status ORDER BY last_update_minute) AS cumulative_buy_count_pos,
    SUM(sell_count_pos) OVER (PARTITION BY product, trade_status ORDER BY last_update_minute) AS cumulative_sell_count_pos,
    latest_price
FROM MinuteCounts;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_118_signal_performance_by_product

                  SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'SELL' THEN alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS sell_alt_net_return, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buy_trade_count, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
                  AS sell_trade_count
FROM     dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all
WHERE  (alt_net_return > 0)
GROUP BY product, DATEADD(MINUTE, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, last_update) / 60 * 60, 0)
ORDER BY HourBucket

views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_120_buy_sell_count_hrly_change]
AS
WITH x AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        HourBucket,
        sell,
        buy,
        update_time,
        DATEPART(HOUR, HourBucket) AS HourOnly,

        -- hour-start baselines
        FIRST_VALUE(sell) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, HourBucket
            ORDER BY update_time
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS base_sell_for_hour,

        FIRST_VALUE(buy) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, HourBucket
            ORDER BY update_time
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS base_buy_for_hour
    FROM dbo.hrly_signal_perf_snapshots
    WHERE DATEPART(HOUR, HourBucket) >= DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE())-0
    -- AND CAST(HourBucket AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
)
SELECT
    x.product,
    x.HourBucket,
    x.sell,
    x.buy,
    x.update_time,
    x.HourOnly,
    x.base_sell_for_hour,
    x.base_buy_for_hour,

    -- point-in-time changes vs hour start
    (x.buy  - x.base_buy_for_hour)  AS buy_change,
    (x.sell - x.base_sell_for_hour) AS sell_change,

    -- RUNNING averages from the start of each hour (ordered by update_time)
    AVG(CAST(x.buy  - x.base_buy_for_hour  AS decimal(18,6)))
        OVER (PARTITION BY x.product, x.HourBucket
              ORDER BY x.update_time
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average_buy_change,

    AVG(CAST(x.sell - x.base_sell_for_hour AS decimal(18,6)))
        OVER (PARTITION BY x.product, x.HourBucket
              ORDER BY x.update_time
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average_sell_change
FROM x;

/* Counts by last_update with BUY/SELL on the same row */
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_121_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted]
AS
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
  t.product,
    t.last_update,
    UPPER(t.signal)    AS signal,
    UPPER(t.zone_name) AS zone_name
  FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS t
  WHERE t.trade_status='open'
)
SELECT
  getdate() as last_update,
  product,
  -- BUY
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='DARKGREEN'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS darkgreen_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='GREEN'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS green_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='PINK'         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pink_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='YELLOW'       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='RED'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='BEYONDSTOP'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyondstop_buy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='BUY'  AND zone_name='BEYONDTARGET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyondTarget_buy,

  -- SELL
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='DARKGREEN'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS darkgreen_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='GREEN'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS green_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='PINK'         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pink_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='YELLOW'       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='RED'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS red_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='BEYONDSTOP'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyondstop_sell,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signal='SELL' AND zone_name='BEYONDTARGET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyondTarget_sell

FROM b
  group by product

views.name: vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2]
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        z.product,
        z.last_update,
        z.beyondTarget_buy, z.darkgreen_buy, z.green_buy, z.yellow_buy, z.pink_buy, z.red_buy,
        z.beyondstop_buy, z.current_price,
        z.beyondstop_sell, z.red_sell, z.pink_sell, z.yellow_sell, z.green_sell, z.darkgreen_sell,
        z.beyondTarget_sell, z.captured_on,

		/* strong combo */
		CASE 
			WHEN (z.red_buy  > 0 AND z.red_sell = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_buy > (z.red_sell * 2)) 
				THEN 'SELL'

			WHEN (z.red_sell > 0 AND z.red_buy  = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_sell > (z.red_buy * 2)) 
				THEN 'BUY'

			ELSE 'HOLD'
		END AS signal_combo,



        /* beyondTarget */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondtarget,

        /* darkgreen */
        CASE
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_darkgreen,

        /* beyondstop */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondstop,

        /* final precedence */
        CASE
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 AND z.beyondstop_buy  > 0) THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN (z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_final_raw
    FROM dbo.zone_counts_minutely_log AS z
    WHERE z.last_update > CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
),
ff AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN b.signal_final_raw END AS sig_nonhold,
        -- forward-fill group PER PRODUCT (increment on each BUY/SELL)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN 1 END)
            OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.product
                ORDER BY b.last_update, b.captured_on
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS grp
    FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
    ff.product,
    ff.last_update,
    ff.beyondTarget_buy, ff.darkgreen_buy, ff.green_buy, ff.yellow_buy, ff.pink_buy, ff.red_buy,
    ff.beyondstop_buy, ff.current_price,
    ff.beyondstop_sell, ff.red_sell, ff.pink_sell, ff.yellow_sell, ff.green_sell, ff.darkgreen_sell,
    ff.beyondTarget_sell, ff.captured_on,
    ff.signal_combo, ff.signal_beyondtarget, ff.signal_darkgreen, ff.signal_beyondstop,
    -- per-product forward-fill of last BUY/SELL; HOLD if none seen yet
    COALESCE(MAX(ff.sig_nonhold) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.product, ff.grp), 'HOLD') AS signal_final
FROM ff;

views.name: vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2_xdate
views.definition:
create VIEW [dbo].[vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2_xdate]
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        z.product,
        z.last_update,
        z.beyondTarget_buy, z.darkgreen_buy, z.green_buy, z.yellow_buy, z.pink_buy, z.red_buy,
        z.beyondstop_buy, z.current_price,
        z.beyondstop_sell, z.red_sell, z.pink_sell, z.yellow_sell, z.green_sell, z.darkgreen_sell,
        z.beyondTarget_sell, z.captured_on,

		/* strong combo */
		CASE 
			WHEN (z.red_buy  > 0 AND z.red_sell = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_buy > (z.red_sell * 2)) 
				THEN 'SELL'

			WHEN (z.red_sell > 0 AND z.red_buy  = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_sell > (z.red_buy * 2)) 
				THEN 'BUY'

			ELSE 'HOLD'
		END AS signal_combo,



        /* beyondTarget */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondtarget,

        /* darkgreen */
        CASE
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_darkgreen,

        /* beyondstop */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondstop,

        /* final precedence */
        CASE
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 AND z.beyondstop_buy  > 0) THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN (z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_final_raw
    FROM dbo.zone_counts_minutely_log AS z
    WHERE z.last_update > dateadd(DAY,-1,CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
),
ff AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN b.signal_final_raw END AS sig_nonhold,
        -- forward-fill group PER PRODUCT (increment on each BUY/SELL)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN 1 END)
            OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.product
                ORDER BY b.last_update, b.captured_on
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS grp
    FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
    ff.product,
    ff.last_update,
    ff.beyondTarget_buy, ff.darkgreen_buy, ff.green_buy, ff.yellow_buy, ff.pink_buy, ff.red_buy,
    ff.beyondstop_buy, ff.current_price,
    ff.beyondstop_sell, ff.red_sell, ff.pink_sell, ff.yellow_sell, ff.green_sell, ff.darkgreen_sell,
    ff.beyondTarget_sell, ff.captured_on,
    ff.signal_combo, ff.signal_beyondtarget, ff.signal_darkgreen, ff.signal_beyondstop,
    -- per-product forward-fill of last BUY/SELL; HOLD if none seen yet
    COALESCE(MAX(ff.sig_nonhold) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.product, ff.grp), 'HOLD') AS signal_final
FROM ff;

views.name: vw_123_zone_counts_with_prev
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_123_zone_counts_with_prev]
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        v.product,
        v.last_update,

        /* current values */
		v.darkgreen_buy,
		v.darkgreen_sell,
		v.green_buy,
		v.green_sell,
        v.pink_buy,
        v.red_buy,
        v.beyondstop_buy,
        v.current_price,
        v.beyondstop_sell,
        v.red_sell,
        v.pink_sell,

        v.signal_combo,
        v.signal_beyondtarget,
        v.signal_darkgreen,
        v.signal_beyondstop,
        v.signal_final,

        /* previous values */
        LAG(v.darkgreen_buy)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_darkgreen_buy,
        LAG(v.darkgreen_sell)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_darkgreen_sell,
        LAG(v.pink_buy)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_pink_buy,
        LAG(v.red_buy)         OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_red_buy,
        LAG(v.beyondstop_buy)  OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_beyondstop_buy,
        LAG(v.beyondstop_sell) OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_beyondstop_sell,
        LAG(v.red_sell)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_red_sell,
        LAG(v.pink_sell)       OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_pink_sell,
        LAG(v.current_price)   OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_current_price
    FROM dbo.vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2 AS v
),
events AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE
            WHEN b.prev_red_buy  = 0 AND b.red_buy  > 0 and b.red_buy>b.red_sell*2 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN b.prev_red_sell = 0 AND b.red_sell > 0 and b.red_sell > b.red_buy*2 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_one_col_raw,
        CASE
            WHEN b.red_sell > b.red_buy * 2 THEN 'buy'
            WHEN b.red_buy > b.red_sell * 2 THEN 'sell'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_red_raw,
        CASE
            WHEN b.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND b.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'buy'
            WHEN b.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND b.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'sell'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_darkgreen_raw
    FROM base AS b
),
marked AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_one_col_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_red_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id_red,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_darkgreen_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id_darkgreen
    FROM events AS e
)
SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT
    product,
    last_update,

    /* current values */
   -- pink_buy,
	prev_darkgreen_buy,
   darkgreen_buy,
   green_buy,
    prev_red_buy,
    red_buy,
  --  beyondstop_buy,
    current_price,
  --  beyondstop_sell,
    prev_red_sell,
    red_sell,
   -- pink_sell,
   green_sell,
	prev_darkgreen_sell,
   darkgreen_sell,

    signal_combo,
    signal_beyondtarget,
    MAX(signal_darkgreen_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id_darkgreen
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_darkgreen,
    signal_beyondstop,
    signal_final,

    /* previous values */
    --prev_pink_buy,
   -- prev_beyondstop_buy,
   -- prev_beyondstop_sell,
    --prev_pink_sell,
    prev_current_price,

    /* forward-filled BUY/SELL only; NULLs before the first event are preserved */
    MAX(signal_one_col_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_one_col,
    MAX(signal_red_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id_red
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_red
FROM marked
ORDER BY last_update DESC;

views.name: vw_124_dna_model_return
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_124_dna_model_return
AS
SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT model, net_return, COUNT(model) AS trade_count
FROM     dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all
GROUP BY model, net_return
HAVING (model LIKE N'%dna%') AND (net_return > 0)

views.name: vw_125_top5_netreturn_signal_counts
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_125_top5_netreturn_signal_counts]
AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        v.product,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal)), '') IS NULL THEN 'HOLD'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal))) IN ('BUY','B')  THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal))) IN ('SELL','S') THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_bucket,
        v.net_return
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open AS v
    WHERE v.net_return IS NOT NULL
      AND v.product IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.product,
        b.signal_bucket,
        b.net_return,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.product
            ORDER BY b.net_return DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM base AS b
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT product, signal_bucket, net_return
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT
    t.product,
    -- counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'BUY'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS buy_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS sell_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'HOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS hold_count,
    COUNT(*)                                                   AS total_in_top5,
    -- sum of net_return for those counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'BUY'  THEN t.net_return ELSE 0 END)  AS buy_count_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'SELL' THEN t.net_return ELSE 0 END)  AS sell_count_value
FROM top5 AS t
GROUP BY t.product;

views.name: vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt]
AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) AS max_loss
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = 'max_product_loss_count'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(pos_alt_net_return AS int) AS pos_alt_net_return,
        product,
        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(signal)))     AS signal
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS v
),
products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT product FROM base
),
signals AS (
    SELECT 'BUY' AS signal UNION ALL SELECT 'SELL'
),
grid AS (
    SELECT p.product, s.signal
    FROM products AS p
    CROSS JOIN signals  AS s
),
counts AS (
    SELECT pos_alt_net_return, product, signal, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY pos_alt_net_return, product, signal
),
side0 AS (  -- losing side
    SELECT
        0 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 0
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
    INNER JOIN cfg
      ON ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) < cfg.max_loss
),
side1 AS (  -- profitable side
    SELECT
        1 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 1
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        s0.pos_alt_net_return,
        s0.product,
        s0.signal,
        s0.trade_count,
        s1.pos_alt_net_return     AS pos_alt_net_return_2,
        s1.product                AS product_2,
        s1.signal                 AS signal_2,
        s1.trade_count            AS trade_count_2,
        CASE
            WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
                 THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
            ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
        END AS trade_count_ratio
    FROM side0 AS s0
    JOIN side1 AS s1
      ON s1.product = s0.product
     AND s1.signal  = s0.signal
    WHERE s1.trade_count > 5
      AND (
            CASE
                WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
                     THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
                ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
            END
          ) < (
            SELECT CAST(config_value AS FLOAT)
            FROM dbo.config
            WHERE config_name = 'min_trade_count_ratio'
          )
)
SELECT TOP (3) *
FROM final
ORDER BY trade_count_ratio ASC;

views.name: vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt_all
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt_all]
AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) AS max_loss
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = 'max_product_loss_count'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(pos_alt_net_return AS int)              AS pos_alt_net_return,
        product,
        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(signal)))                  AS signal
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS v
),
products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT product FROM base
),
signals AS (
    SELECT 'BUY' AS signal UNION ALL SELECT 'SELL'
),
grid AS (
    SELECT p.product, s.signal
    FROM products AS p
    CROSS JOIN signals  AS s
),
counts AS (
    SELECT pos_alt_net_return, product, signal, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY pos_alt_net_return, product, signal
),
side0 AS (  -- left side, filtered by max_loss
    SELECT
        0 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 0
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
    INNER JOIN cfg
      ON ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) < 10000
),
side1 AS (  -- right side, no max_loss filter
    SELECT
        1 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        ISNULL(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 1
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
)
SELECT
    s0.pos_alt_net_return,
    s0.product,
    s0.signal,
    s0.trade_count,
    s1.pos_alt_net_return     AS pos_alt_net_return_2,
    s1.product                AS product_2,
    s1.signal                 AS signal_2,
    s1.trade_count            AS trade_count_2,
    CASE
        WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
             THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
        ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
    END                       AS trade_count_ratio
FROM side0 AS s0
JOIN side1 AS s1
  ON s1.product = s0.product
 AND s1.signal  = s0.signal
WHERE s1.trade_count > 5
  AND (
        CASE
            WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
                 THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
            ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
        END
      ) > 0
	  /*(
        SELECT CAST(config_value AS FLOAT)
        FROM dbo.config
        WHERE config_name = 'min_trade_count_ratio'
      )*/
	  ;

views.name: vw_127_closed_trades_lastXmin_summary
views.definition:
CREATE     VIEW [dbo].[vw_127_closed_trades_lastXmin_summary]
AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) AS minutes_back
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = 'view_analysis_period'
),
recent AS (
    SELECT v.*
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all v
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    WHERE v.created >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -cfg.minutes_back, GETDATE())
)
SELECT 
product,
    -- total trades (open + closed)
    COUNT(*) AS total_count_all_trades,

    -- closed trades only
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.trade_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS trade_count_closed,

    -- buy/sell counts by signal
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY' and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'  THEN 1 END) AS buy_count_closed,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL' and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS sell_count_closed,

    -- pos_net_return splits
--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'    THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_buy_open,
--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'  THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_sell_open,

    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'    THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_buy_closed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'  THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_sell_closed,

    -- pos_alt_net_return splits
--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_buy_open,
--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_sell_open,

    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_buy_closed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_sell_closed

FROM recent r

group by product

views.name: vw_200_zone_distribution_latest
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_200_zone_distribution_latest]
AS
WITH t AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        LOWER(signal) AS sig,
        UPPER(zone_name) AS zone_name
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open
    WHERE zone_name IS NOT NULL
),
latest_quotes AS (
    SELECT
        q.code,
        (q.bid + q.ask) / 2.0 AS latest_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.code ORDER BY q.[timestamp] DESC) AS rn
    FROM dbo.vw_000_fx_quotes AS q
)
SELECT
    z.product,

    -- SELL: R9, R5..R1
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R9' THEN 1 END) AS s_R9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R5' THEN 1 END) AS s_R5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R4' THEN 1 END) AS s_R4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R3' THEN 1 END) AS s_R3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R2' THEN 1 END) AS s_R2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R1' THEN 1 END) AS s_R1,

    -- SELL: G1..G5, G9
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G1' THEN 1 END) AS s_G1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G2' THEN 1 END) AS s_G2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G3' THEN 1 END) AS s_G3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G4' THEN 1 END) AS s_G4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G5' THEN 1 END) AS s_G5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G9' THEN 1 END) AS s_G9,

    -- Current mid-price
    q.latest_price,

    -- BUY: R9, R5..R1
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R9' THEN 1 END) AS b_R9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R5' THEN 1 END) AS b_R5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R4' THEN 1 END) AS b_R4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R3' THEN 1 END) AS b_R3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R2' THEN 1 END) AS b_R2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R1' THEN 1 END) AS b_R1,

    -- BUY: G1..G5, G9
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G1' THEN 1 END) AS b_G1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G2' THEN 1 END) AS b_G2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G3' THEN 1 END) AS b_G3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G4' THEN 1 END) AS b_G4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G5' THEN 1 END) AS b_G5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G9' THEN 1 END) AS b_G9

FROM t AS z
LEFT JOIN latest_quotes AS q
    ON q.code = z.product AND q.rn = 1
GROUP BY
    z.product, q.latest_price;

views.name: vw_200_zone_distribution_latest_all
views.definition:
create   VIEW [dbo].[vw_200_zone_distribution_latest_all]
AS
SELECT TOP (1000) snapshot_time, product, s_G9, s_G5, b_R4, b_R5, b_R9, latest_price, s_R9, s_R5, s_R4, b_G5, b_G9
FROM     dbo.zone_distribution_snapshots
ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_200_zone_distribution_latest_gbp
AS
SELECT TOP (3000) snapshot_time, product, s_G9, s_G5, s_G4, s_G3, s_G2, s_G1, latest_price, b_G1, b_G2, b_G3, b_G4, b_G5, b_G9
