CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_201_zone_distribution_snapshots] AS SELECT snapshot_time, product, s_G9, s_G5, s_G4, s_G3, s_G2, s_G1, latest_price, b_G1, b_G2, b_G3, b_G4, b_G5, b_G9 FROM dbo.zone_distribution_snapshots
where snapshot_time>cast(getdate() as date)

views.name: vw_201_zone_distribution_snapshots_signal
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_201_zone_distribution_snapshots_signal]
AS
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        snapshot_time,
        s_G9, s_G5, s_G4, s_G3, s_G2, s_G1,
        b_G9, b_G5, b_G4, b_G3, b_G2, b_G1,
        latest_price,

        LAG(s_G9) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G9,
        LAG(s_G5) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G5,
        LAG(s_G4) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G4,
        LAG(s_G3) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G3,
        LAG(s_G2) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G2,
        LAG(s_G1) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_s_G1,

        LAG(b_G9) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G9,
        LAG(b_G5) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G5,
        LAG(b_G4) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G4,
        LAG(b_G3) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G3,
        LAG(b_G2) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G2,
        LAG(b_G1) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G1
    FROM dbo.vw_201_zone_distribution_snapshots
)
SELECT
    snapshot_time,
    product,
    s_G9, s_G5, s_G4, s_G3, s_G2, s_G1,
    latest_price,
    b_G1, b_G2, b_G3, b_G4, b_G5, b_G9,

    CASE WHEN prev_s_G9 > 0 AND s_G9 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg9,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G5 > 0 AND s_G5 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg5,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G4 > 0 AND s_G4 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg4,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G3 > 0 AND s_G3 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg3,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G2 > 0 AND s_G2 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg2,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G1 > 0 AND s_G1 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg1,

    CASE WHEN prev_b_G1 > 0 AND b_G1 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg1,
    CASE WHEN prev_b_G2 > 0 AND b_G2 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg2,
    CASE WHEN prev_b_G3 > 0 AND b_G3 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg3,
    CASE WHEN prev_b_G4 > 0 AND b_G4 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg4,
    CASE WHEN prev_b_G5 > 0 AND b_G5 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg5,
    CASE WHEN prev_b_G9 > 0 AND b_G9 IS NULL THEN 'SELL' END AS bg9
FROM ranked;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_210_breach_next_same_signal]
AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(config_value AS float) AS breach_min_target_profit
    FROM dbo.config
    WHERE config_name = 'breach_min_target_profit'
),
breaches AS (
    SELECT
        c.trade_status AS breach_trade_status,
        c.guid         AS breach_guid,
        c.product,
        c.model,
        c.signal,
        c.created,
        c.last_update,
        c.alt_net_return,
        c.target_profit,
        c.target_loss
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all c
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    WHERE c.trade_status = 'CLOSED'                    -- only closed trades as breaches
      AND c.alt_net_return < (c.target_profit * -1)    -- big loss
      AND c.target_profit >
          ISNULL(cfg.breach_min_target_profit, 300)    -- threshold from config, default 300
      -- AND c.model LIKE '%DNA%'                      -- optional filter
)
SELECT
    b.product,
    b.model,
    b.signal,

    -- breach trade
    b.breach_trade_status,
    b.breach_guid       AS breach_guid,
    b.created           AS breach_created,
    b.last_update       AS breach_last_update,
    b.alt_net_return    AS breach_alt_net_return,
    b.target_profit     AS breach_target_profit,
    b.target_loss       AS breach_target_loss,

    -- next trade with same model+signal after breach.last_update
    n.trade_status      AS next_trade_status,
    n.guid              AS next_guid,
    n.created           AS next_created,
    n.last_update       AS next_last_update,
    n.alt_net_return    AS next_alt_net_return,
    n.target_profit     AS next_target_profit
FROM breaches b
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) c2.*
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all c2
    WHERE c2.model  = b.model
      AND c2.signal = b.signal
      AND c2.created > b.last_update
    ORDER BY c2.created ASC
) n;

CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_310_recent_closed_summary_by_product_signal
AS
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        signal,
        net_return
    FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed
    WHERE created >= DATEADD(HOUR, -2, GETDATE())  -- last 2 hours
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        signal,
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count_by_product_signal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_closed_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) AS positive_net_return_sum
    FROM src
    GROUP BY product, signal
)
SELECT
    a.product,
    a.signal,

    -- count of closed by product (all signals)
    SUM(a.closed_count_by_product_signal) OVER (PARTITION BY a.product) AS closed_count_by_product,

    -- count of positive closes by product, signal
    a.positive_closed_count,

    -- positives as % of total by product, signal
    CASE 
        WHEN a.closed_count_by_product_signal = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(a.positive_closed_count * 100.0 
                  / a.closed_count_by_product_signal AS decimal(5,2))
    END AS positives_pct_of_total_by_product_signal,

    -- net_return value of positive close by product, signal
    a.positive_net_return_sum AS net_return_positive_sum_by_product_signal

FROM agg AS a;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_700_GreedyBuckets
AS
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT
        t.model,
        t.product,
        t.signal,
        -- derive entry_bucket + time_bin
        CAST(FLOOR(t.entry_price * 1000) AS int) AS entry_bucket,
        CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, '2000-01-01', t.created) / 5 AS int) AS time_bin,
        t.net_return_sum,
        t.alt_net_return_sum
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS t
)
, NetBranch AS (
    SELECT
        model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin,
        CAST('net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
        COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        SUM(net_return_sum) AS return_sum,
        AVG(CAST(net_return_sum AS float)) AS avg_return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin
)
, AltBranch AS (
    SELECT
        model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin,
        CAST('alt_net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
        COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        SUM(alt_net_return_sum) AS return_sum,
        AVG(CAST(alt_net_return_sum AS float)) AS avg_return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin
)
SELECT * FROM NetBranch
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM AltBranch;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_700_GreedyBuckets_Hist]
AS
WITH Base AS (

    t.net_return,         -- per-trade return (closed)
    t.alt_net_return
  FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed_arc AS t   -- or your canonical closed-trades source
)
, Net AS (
  SELECT model,product,signal,entry_bucket,time_bin,
         CAST('net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
         COUNT(*) trade_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN net_return <=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
         SUM(net_return)   AS return_sum,
         AVG(CAST(net_return AS float)) AS avg_return,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN net_return>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
  FROM Base GROUP BY model,product,signal,entry_bucket,time_bin
)
, Alt AS (
  SELECT model,product,signal,entry_bucket,time_bin,
         CAST('alt_net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
         COUNT(*) trade_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return <=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
         SUM(alt_net_return)   AS return_sum,
         AVG(CAST(alt_net_return AS float)) AS avg_return,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
  FROM Base GROUP BY model,product,signal,entry_bucket,time_bin
)
SELECT * FROM Net
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM Alt;

CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_700_selectable_now
AS
WITH T AS (
    SELECT t.guid, t.product, t.model, t.signal, t.created,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY t.product, t.model, t.signal
             ORDER BY t.created ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.combined_trades_open t
    JOIN dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel p
      ON p.product = t.product
     AND p.signal  = t.signal
     AND p.entry_bucket = dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket(t.entry_price)
     AND p.time_bin     = dbo.fn_700_time_bin(t.created)
     AND p.return_type  = N'alt_net_return'
    WHERE p.trade_count >= 10
      AND p.hit_rate    >= 0.55
      AND p.avg_return  >= 5.0
      AND t.tradeable = 0   -- inserted, but not yet promoted
)
SELECT guid, product, model, signal, created
FROM T
WHERE rn = 1;  -- only the first trade per product/model/signal is “live”

views.name: vw_700_tbl_model_signal_net_diff
views.definition:
/* Optional:
   -- UPDATE dbo.config SET config_value='2025-09-05 21:30:00.000' WHERE config_name='tbl_model_signal_net_since';
   -- UPDATE dbo.config SET config_value='gbp'                    WHERE config_name='tbl_model_signal_net_product';
*/

CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_700_tbl_model_signal_net_diff
AS
WITH cutoff AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(config_value AS datetime2(3)) AS since_dt
    FROM dbo.config WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE config_name = 'tbl_model_signal_net_since'
),
base AS (
    SELECT msn.*
    FROM dbo.tbl_model_signal_net AS msn
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
            ISNULL( (SELECT since_dt FROM cutoff),
                    DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) ) AS since_dt,
            ISNULL( (SELECT config_value
                     FROM dbo.config WITH (NOLOCK)
                     WHERE config_name = 'tbl_model_signal_net_product'),
                    N'gbp') AS product_filter
    ) c
    WHERE msn.update_time >= c.since_dt
      AND msn.product     = c.product_filter
),
first_time AS (
    SELECT product, model, signal, MIN(update_time) AS first_update_time
    FROM base
    GROUP BY product, model, signal
),
first_vals AS (
    SELECT b.product, b.model, b.signal,
           b.update_time,
           b.net_return_sum        AS base_net_return_sum,
           b.alt_net_return_sum    AS base_alt_net_return_sum
    FROM base b
    JOIN first_time ft
      ON ft.product = b.product
     AND ft.model   = b.model
     AND ft.signal  = b.signal
     AND ft.first_update_time = b.update_time
)
SELECT
    b.update_time,
    b.product,
    b.model,
    b.signal,
    (b.net_return_sum     - fv.base_net_return_sum)     AS net_return_diff,
    (b.alt_net_return_sum - fv.base_alt_net_return_sum) AS alt_net_return_diff,
    b.net_return_sum,
    b.alt_net_return_sum,
    fv.base_net_return_sum,
    fv.base_alt_net_return_sum,
    CASE WHEN b.update_time = fv.update_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_baseline
FROM base b
JOIN first_vals fv
  ON fv.product = b.product
 AND fv.model   = b.model
 AND fv.signal  = b.signal;

views.name: vw_800_hybrid_controls
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_800_hybrid_controls
AS
WITH latest AS
(
    SELECT
        rs.regime_id,
        rs.product,
        rs.model,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.product, rs.model ORDER BY rs.evaluated_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM dbo.tbl_800_regime_state rs
)
SELECT
    rs.product,
    rs.model,
    rs.product_type,
    rs.regime_state,
    rs.fast_side,
    rs.slow_side,
    rs.metrics_id,
    m.window_end,
    m.buy_trade_count,
    m.sell_trade_count,
    m.buy_avg_duration_minutes,
    m.sell_avg_duration_minutes,
    m.dur_ratio,
    m.count_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%'
             AND dbo.fn_800_fast_exposure_safe(rs.product, rs.model, rs.fast_side) = 1 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS can_stuff,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%'
             AND (
                    (rs.fast_side = 'BUY'  AND m.sell_avg_duration_minutes >= cfg.slow_duration_threshold)
                 OR (rs.fast_side = 'SELL' AND m.buy_avg_duration_minutes  >= cfg.slow_duration_threshold)
                 ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS must_ghost,
    CASE WHEN rs.regime_state = 'TRANSITION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS transition_active,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%' AND ISNULL(m.dur_ratio, 0) >= cfg.breakdown_ratio THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS auto_flip_armed
FROM latest l
JOIN dbo.tbl_800_regime_state rs ON l.regime_id = rs.regime_id AND l.rn = 1
JOIN dbo.tbl_800_trade_metrics m ON rs.metrics_id = m.metrics_id
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        slow_duration_threshold = ISNULL(
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,4), (SELECT TOP (1) config_value FROM dbo.config WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE config_name = 'hybrid_slow_duration_threshold')),
            25.0
        ),
        breakdown_ratio = ISNULL(
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,4), (SELECT TOP (1) config_value FROM dbo.config WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE config_name = 'hybrid_fast_breakdown_ratio')),
            1.50
        )
) cfg;

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_900_dynamic_leadership_live] AS
WITH latest_signal AS (

        product,
        model,
        signal,
        latest_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY last_update DESC) AS rn
    FROM vwCombined_trades_open
)
SELECT TOP (5)
    GETDATE() AS snapshot_time,
    v.model,
    ls.signal,
    ls.latest_price,
    SUM(v.net_return) AS net_return
FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS v

  ON v.model = ls.model AND ls.rn = 1
WHERE v.net_return IS NOT NULL AND v.product='gbp'
  AND v.model NOT LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
GROUP BY v.product,v.model, ls.signal, ls.latest_price
ORDER BY SUM(v.net_return) DESC;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_900_dynamic_leadership_live_alt]
AS

        signal,
        latest_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY last_update DESC) AS rn
    FROM vwCombined_trades_open
),
RankedModels AS ( -- New CTE for ranking
    SELECT
        GETDATE() AS snapshot_time,
        v.model,
        v.product,
        ls.signal,
        ls.latest_price,
        SUM(v.alt_net_return) AS alt_net_return_sum,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY SUM(v.alt_net_return) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS v
    JOIN latest_signal AS ls
      ON v.model = ls.model
     AND ls.rn = 1
    WHERE v.alt_net_return IS NOT NULL
      AND v.trade_status = 'closed'
	  and v.model like '%dna%'
    GROUP BY v.model, v.product, ls.signal, ls.latest_price
)
SELECT -- Removed TOP (1)
    snapshot_time,
    model,
    product,
    signal,
    latest_price,
    alt_net_return_sum
FROM RankedModels
WHERE rnk = 1; -- Filter for top model per product

CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_min_closed_alt_returns_minutely_20250819
AS
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(minute, DATEDIFF(minute, 0, c.last_update), 0) AS last_update_minute,
        CAST(COALESCE(c.alt_net_return, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,8))   AS alt_net_return,
        LOWER(COALESCE(c.signal, ''))                          AS signal
    FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed AS c
    WHERE c.last_update >= '2025-08-18T00:00:00'
      AND c.last_update <  '2025-08-19T00:00:00'
      AND c.trade_reason IS NULL
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.last_update_minute,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('buy','b')  THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS buy_alt_net_return,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS sell_alt_net_return
    FROM Base b
    GROUP BY b.last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    a.last_update_minute AS last_update,
    a.buy_alt_net_return,
    a.sell_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.buy_alt_net_return)  OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_buy_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.sell_alt_net_return) OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_sell_alt_net_return
FROM Agg a;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_top_one_frequency] AS
SELECT product,
strategy_and_params, direction, COUNT(*) AS frequency_count, 
(SELECT TOP 1 t2.total_net_return FROM dbo.tbl_top_one t2 
WHERE t2.product = t1.product AND 
t2.strategy_and_params = t1.strategy_and_params AND
t2.direction = t1.direction ORDER BY t2.last_update DESC) AS total_net_return, 
MIN(last_update) AS first_seen, MAX(last_update) AS last_seen,
DATEDIFF(HOUR, min(last_update), GETDATE()) AS age_hh,
DATEDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(last_update), GETDATE()) AS minutes_since_last_seen 
FROM dbo.tbl_top_one t1 
GROUP BY product, strategy_and_params, direction;

views.name: vwCombined_trades_closed
views.definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_closed]
AS
SELECT 
    guid, 
    model, 
    product, 
    product_type, 
    created, 
    last_update, 
    DATEDIFF(minute, created, last_update) AS age, 
    signal, 
    entry_price, 
    latest_price, 
    entry_price2, 
    latest_price2, 
    trade_quantity, 
    commission, 
    target_profit, 
    target_loss, 
    rl_signal, 
    tradeable, 
    net_return, 
    alt_net_return,
    /* NEW: actual_net */
    CASE 
        WHEN flip_trade IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN flip_trade = 0 THEN net_return
        WHEN flip_trade = 1 THEN alt_net_return
    END AS actual_net,
    pos_net_return_buy, 
    pos_net_return_sell, 
    trade_diff, 
    RL_Check, 
    percent_profit, 
    percent_loss, 
    buy_count, 
    sell_count, 
    linked, 
    int_profit, 
    int_profit_time, 
    close_type, 
    min_net_return, 
    min_net_return_time, 
    max_net_return, 
    max_net_return_time, 
    trade_reason, 
    flip_trade, 
    CAST(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_net_return, 
    CAST(CASE WHEN alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_alt_net_return, 
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, created, GETDATE()) AS created_age,
    DATEDIFF(minute, created, last_update) AS trade_duration,

    /* â”€â”€ Zone assignment using net_return â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
    zone_name =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New zone categorization (R1-R5, G1-G5, R9, G9)
        -- R9: Beyond Stop Loss
        -- R1-R5: Loss blocks (R1 smallest loss, R5 largest loss)
        -- G1-G5: Profit blocks (G1 smallest profit, G5 largest profit)
        -- G9: Beyond Target Profit
        WHEN net_return IS NULL OR target_profit IS NULL OR target_loss IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss THEN 'R9' -- Beyond Stop Loss
        WHEN net_return > target_profit THEN 'G9' -- Beyond Target Profit
        -- Profit Zones (G1-G5)
        WHEN net_return >= 0 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.2 THEN 'G1'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.2 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.4 THEN 'G2'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.4 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.6 THEN 'G3'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.6 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.8 THEN 'G4'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.8 AND net_return <= target_profit THEN 'G5'
        -- Loss Zones (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative, so multiplication by 0.x makes it less negative (closest to 0)
        WHEN net_return < 0 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.8 THEN 'R1' -- Smallest loss (e.g., -80 to 0 for target_loss -100)
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.6 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.4 THEN 'R2' -- e.g., -60 to -40
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.4 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.2 THEN 'R3' -- e.g., -40 to -20
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.2 AND net_return >= target_loss THEN 'R4' -- e.g., -20 to -100
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.8 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.6 THEN 'R5' -- e.g., -100 to -80
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END,
    zone_rank =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New numerical ranks for zone categorization
        WHEN net_return IS NULL OR target_profit IS NULL OR target_loss IS NULL THEN -1
        WHEN net_return < target_loss THEN 0 -- R9
        WHEN net_return > target_profit THEN 11 -- G9
        -- Profit Ranks (G1-G5)
        WHEN net_return >= 0 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.2 THEN 6 -- G1
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.2 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.4 THEN 7 -- G2
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.4 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.6 THEN 8 -- G3
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.6 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.8 THEN 9 -- G4
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.8 AND net_return <= target_profit THEN 10 -- G5
        -- Loss Ranks (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative
        WHEN net_return < 0 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.8 THEN 5 -- R1
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.6 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.4 THEN 4 -- R2
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.4 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.2 THEN 3 -- R3
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.2 AND net_return >= target_loss THEN 2 -- R4
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.8 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.6 THEN 1 -- R5
        ELSE -1
      END,
	  g_close_time,
	  g_net_return,
	  g_alt_net_return
FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed
WHERE
    created >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
    AND DATEDIFF(minute, created, GETDATE()) <= 1440
    AND created >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE());

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_closed_arc]
AS
SELECT 
    guid, 
    model, 
    product, 
    product_type, 
    created, 
    last_update, 
    DATEDIFF(minute, created, last_update) AS age, 
    signal, 
    entry_price,

    entry_price2,

    trade_quantity, 
    commission, 
    target_profit, 
    target_loss, 
    rl_signal, 
    tradeable, 
    net_return, 
    alt_net_return,

    /* ===== DAILY CUMULATIVE METRICS BY MODEL ===== */
    SUM(net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS net_return_sum,

    SUM(alt_net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS alt_net_return_sum,

    COUNT(1) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trade_count,

	COUNT(1) OVER (
    PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
) AS trade_count_for_model,

    /* ===== ACTUAL NET (FLIP-AWARE) ===== */
    CASE 
        WHEN flip_trade IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN flip_trade = 0 THEN net_return
        WHEN flip_trade = 1 THEN alt_net_return
    END AS actual_net,

    pos_net_return_buy, 
    pos_net_return_sell, 
    trade_diff, 
    RL_Check, 
    percent_profit, 
    percent_loss, 
    buy_count, 
    sell_count, 
    linked, 
    int_profit, 
    int_profit_time, 
    close_type, 
    min_net_return, 
    min_net_return_time, 
    max_net_return, 
    max_net_return_time, 
    trade_reason, 
    flip_trade, 

    CAST(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_net_return, 
    CAST(CASE WHEN alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_alt_net_return, 

    DATEDIFF(HOUR, created, GETDATE()) AS created_age,
    DATEDIFF(minute, created, last_update) AS trade_duration,

    /* ================= ZONE ASSIGNMENT (NET_RETURN) ================= */
    zone_name =
      CASE
        WHEN net_return IS NULL OR target_profit IS NULL OR target_loss IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss THEN 'R9'
        WHEN net_return > target_profit THEN 'G9'

        WHEN net_return >= 0 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.2 THEN 'G1'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.2 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.4 THEN 'G2'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.4 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.6 THEN 'G3'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.6 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.8 THEN 'G4'
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.8 AND net_return <= target_profit THEN 'G5'

        WHEN net_return < 0 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.8 THEN 'R1'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.6 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.4 THEN 'R2'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.4 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.2 THEN 'R3'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.2 AND net_return >= target_loss THEN 'R4'
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.8 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.6 THEN 'R5'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END,

    zone_rank =
      CASE
        WHEN net_return IS NULL OR target_profit IS NULL OR target_loss IS NULL THEN -1
        WHEN net_return < target_loss THEN 0
        WHEN net_return > target_profit THEN 11

        WHEN net_return >= 0 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.2 THEN 6
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.2 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.4 THEN 7
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.4 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.6 THEN 8
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.6 AND net_return < target_profit * 0.8 THEN 9
        WHEN net_return >= target_profit * 0.8 AND net_return <= target_profit THEN 10

        WHEN net_return < 0 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.8 THEN 5
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.6 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.4 THEN 4
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.4 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.2 THEN 3
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.2 AND net_return >= target_loss THEN 2
        WHEN net_return < target_loss * 0.8 AND net_return >= target_loss * 0.6 THEN 1
        ELSE -1
      END

FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed_arc
WHERE model LIKE 'DNA%'

create   VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_closed_arc2]
AS
WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT
    expire_seconds = COALESCE(
        TRY_CAST((SELECT TOP(1) config_value
                  FROM dbo.config
                  WHERE config_name = N'EXPIRE') AS INT), 10800),
    today_start    = CAST(CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AS datetime),
    tomorrow_start = DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AS datetime))
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    o.guid, o.model, o.product, o.product_type,
    o.created, o.last_update,
    DATEDIFF(minute, o.created, GETDATE()) AS age,
    o.signal, o.entry_price, o.latest_price, o.entry_price2, o.latest_price2,

    o.net_return, o.alt_net_return,
    CASE
      WHEN o.flip_trade IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN o.flip_trade = 0     THEN o.net_return
      WHEN o.flip_trade = 1     THEN o.alt_net_return
    END AS actual_net,
    o.pos_net_return_buy, o.pos_net_return_sell,
    o.trade_diff, o.RL_Check, o.percent_profit, o.percent_loss,
    o.buy_count, o.sell_count, o.linked, o.int_profit, o.int_profit_time,

    DATEDIFF(HOUR, o.created, GETDATE()) AS created_age,
    DATEDIFF(minute, o.created, o.last_update) AS trade_duration,
    /* zones */
    zone_name =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New zone categorization (R1-R5, G1-G5, R9, G9)
        -- R9: Beyond Stop Loss
        -- R1-R5: Loss blocks (R1 smallest loss, R5 largest loss)
        -- G1-G5: Profit blocks (G1 smallest profit, G5 largest profit)
        -- G9: Beyond Target Profit
        WHEN o.net_return IS NULL OR o.target_profit IS NULL OR o.target_loss IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss THEN 'R9' -- Beyond Stop Loss
        WHEN o.net_return > o.target_profit THEN 'G9' -- Beyond Target Profit
        -- Profit Zones (G1-G5)
        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 'G1'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 'G2'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 'G3'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 'G4'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 'G5'
        -- Loss Zones (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative, so multiplication by 0.x makes it less negative (closest to 0)
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 'R1' -- Smallest loss (e.g., -80 to 0 for target_loss -100)
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 'R2' -- e.g., -60 to -40
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 'R3' -- e.g., -40 to -20
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 'R4' -- e.g., -20 to -100
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 'R5' -- e.g., -100 to -80
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END,
    zone_rank =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New numerical ranks for zone categorization
        WHEN o.net_return IS NULL OR o.target_profit IS NULL OR o.target_loss IS NULL THEN -1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss THEN 0 -- R9
        WHEN o.net_return > o.target_profit THEN 11 -- G9
        -- Profit Ranks (G1-G5)
        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 6 -- G1
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 7 -- G2
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 8 -- G3
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 9 -- G4
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 10 -- G5
        -- Loss Ranks (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 5 -- R1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 4 -- R2
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 3 -- R3
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 2 -- R4
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 1 -- R5
        ELSE -1
      END
	  --o.g_close_time,
	  --o.g_net_return,
	  --o.g_alt_net_return
  FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed_arc AS o
),
red_seq AS (
  SELECT
    b.guid,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'buy'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_buy,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'sell'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_sell
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
  b.*,
  rs.red_buy,
  rs.red_sell
FROM base AS b
LEFT JOIN red_seq AS rs
  ON rs.guid = b.guid
CROSS JOIN cfg

views.name: vwCombined_trades_closed_output_top200
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_closed_output_top200]
AS
WITH DailyModelTotals AS (
    -- Pass 1: Get final daily P&L from the pre-calculated CACHE table (Fast SELECT)
    SELECT 
        model,
        trade_date,
        MAX(net_return_sum) as net_final,
        MAX(alt_net_return_sum) as alt_final
    FROM dbo.dna_pnl_stream_cache
    GROUP BY model, trade_date
),
DailyRanks AS (
    -- Pass 2: Rank the pre-calculated winners
    SELECT 
        model,
        trade_date,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY trade_date 
            ORDER BY (CASE WHEN net_final >= alt_final THEN net_final ELSE alt_final END) DESC
        ) AS daily_rank
    FROM DailyModelTotals
),
Winners AS (
    -- Pass 3: Narrow down to Top 200
    SELECT model, trade_date 
    FROM DailyRanks 
    WHERE daily_rank <= 200
)
-- FINAL RESULT: Zero math, just an indexed join on physical data
-- [V20260125_1835] Added net_return for signal-level accuracy
SELECT
    r.model,
    r.product,
    r.created,
    r.signal,
    r.net_return,
    r.net_return_sum,
    r.alt_net_return_sum,
    r.buy_net_return_sum,
    r.sell_net_return_sum,
    r.trade_count
FROM dbo.dna_pnl_stream_cache r
INNER JOIN Winners w ON r.model = w.model AND r.trade_date = w.trade_date;

                  WHERE config_name = N'EXPIRE') AS INT), 10800),
    today_start    = CAST(CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AS datetime),
    tomorrow_start = DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) AS datetime))
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    o.guid, o.model, o.product, o.product_type,
    o.created, o.last_update,
    DATEDIFF(minute, o.created, GETDATE()) AS age,
    o.signal, o.entry_price, o.latest_price, o.entry_price2, o.latest_price2,
    o.commission, o.target_profit, o.target_loss, o.rl_signal, o.tradeable,
    o.net_return, o.alt_net_return,
    CASE
      WHEN o.flip_trade IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN o.flip_trade = 0     THEN o.net_return
      WHEN o.flip_trade = 1     THEN o.alt_net_return
    END AS actual_net,
    o.pos_net_return_buy, o.pos_net_return_sell,
    o.trade_diff, o.RL_Check, o.percent_profit, o.percent_loss,
    o.buy_count, o.sell_count, o.linked, o.int_profit, o.int_profit_time,
    o.trade_quantity, o.min_net_return, o.min_net_return_time,
    o.max_net_return, o.max_net_return_time, o.trade_reason, o.flip_trade,
    CAST(CASE WHEN o.net_return     > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_net_return,
    CAST(CASE WHEN o.alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TINYINT) AS pos_alt_net_return,
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, o.created, GETDATE()) AS created_age,
    DATEDIFF(minute, o.created, o.last_update) AS trade_duration,
    /* zones */
    zone_name =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New zone categorization (R1-R5, G1-G5, R9, G9)
        -- R9: Beyond Stop Loss
        -- R1-R5: Loss blocks (R1 smallest loss, R5 largest loss)
        -- G1-G5: Profit blocks (G1 smallest profit, G5 largest profit)
        -- G9: Beyond Target Profit
        WHEN o.net_return IS NULL OR o.target_profit IS NULL OR o.target_loss IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss THEN 'R9' -- Beyond Stop Loss
        WHEN o.net_return > o.target_profit THEN 'G9' -- Beyond Target Profit
        -- Profit Zones (G1-G5)
        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 'G1'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 'G2'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 'G3'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 'G4'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 'G5'
        -- Loss Zones (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative, so multiplication by 0.x makes it less negative (closest to 0)
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 'R1' -- Smallest loss (e.g., -80 to 0 for target_loss -100)
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 'R2' -- e.g., -60 to -40
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 'R3' -- e.g., -40 to -20
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 'R4' -- e.g., -20 to -100
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 'R5' -- e.g., -100 to -80
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END,
    zone_rank =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New numerical ranks for zone categorization
        WHEN o.net_return IS NULL OR o.target_profit IS NULL OR o.target_loss IS NULL THEN -1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss THEN 0 -- R9
        WHEN o.net_return > o.target_profit THEN 11 -- G9
        -- Profit Ranks (G1-G5)
        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 6 -- G1
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 7 -- G2
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 8 -- G3
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 9 -- G4
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 10 -- G5
        -- Loss Ranks (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 5 -- R1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 4 -- R2
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 3 -- R3
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 2 -- R4
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 1 -- R5
        ELSE -1
      END,
	  o.g_close_time,
	  o.g_net_return,
	  o.g_alt_net_return
  FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS o
),
red_seq AS (
  SELECT
    b.guid,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'buy'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_buy,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'sell'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_sell
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
  b.*,
  rs.red_buy,
  rs.red_sell
FROM base AS b
LEFT JOIN red_seq AS rs
  ON rs.guid = b.guid
CROSS JOIN cfg
WHERE
  b.created >= cfg.today_start
  AND b.created <  cfg.tomorrow_start
  AND b.created >= DATEADD(SECOND, -cfg.expire_seconds, GETDATE());

views.name: vwCombined_trades_output

create     VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_output]
AS
SELECT
    guid,
    model,
    product,
    created,
    net_return,
    alt_net_return,

    /* ===== DAILY CUMULATIVE METRICS BY MODEL ===== */
    SUM(net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS net_return_sum,

    SUM(alt_net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS alt_net_return_sum,

    COUNT(1) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trade_count

FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
WHERE model LIKE 'DNA%'

views.name: vwCombined_trades_output_top200
views.definition: CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwCombined_trades_output_top200] AS WITH RawData AS ( SELECT model, product, created, signal, net_return, alt_net_return, trade_date, 'Closed' as trade_status, g_close_time, 0 as tradeable FROM dbo.dna_pnl_stream_cache WHERE trade_date = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) UNION ALL SELECT model, product, created, signal, net_return, alt_net_return, CAST(created AS date) as trade_date, 'Open' as trade_status, NULL as g_close_time, tradeable FROM dbo.combined_trades_open WHERE CAST(created AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND model LIKE 'DNA%' ), RollingTotals AS ( SELECT model, product, created, signal, net_return, SUM(net_return) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY created, product) AS net_return_sum, SUM(alt_net_return) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY created, product) AS alt_net_return_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'BUY' THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY created, product) AS buy_net_return_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'SELL' THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY created, product) AS sell_net_return_sum, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY model ORDER BY created, product) AS trade_count, trade_date, trade_status, g_close_time, tradeable FROM RawData ), DailyModelTotals AS ( SELECT model, trade_date, MAX(net_return_sum) AS net_final, MAX(alt_net_return_sum) AS alt_final FROM RollingTotals GROUP BY model, trade_date ), DailyRanks AS ( SELECT model, trade_date, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN net_final >= alt_final THEN net_final ELSE alt_final END DESC ) AS daily_rank FROM DailyModelTotals ), Winners AS ( SELECT model, trade_date FROM DailyRanks WHERE daily_rank <= 200 ) SELECT r.model, r.product, r.created, r.signal, r.net_return, r.net_return_sum, r.alt_net_return_sum, r.buy_net_return_sum, r.sell_net_return_sum, r.trade_count, r.g_close_time AS exit_time, r.trade_status AS status, CASE WHEN r.tradeable = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_live FROM RollingTotals r INNER JOIN Winners w ON w.model = r.model AND w.trade_date = r.trade_date;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vwProuctSummaryData_cross_output
AS
SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT product, trade_date, time_block, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN trades_in_profit ELSE 0 END) AS [trade_in_profit (buy)], SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN trades_in_profit ELSE 0 END) 
                  AS [trade_in_profit (sell)], AVG(CAST(latest_price AS FLOAT)) AS avg_latest_price, SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN trades_in_profit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN trades_in_profit ELSE 0 END)

routines.name: fn_decode_dna_array
routines.definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION dbo.fn_decode_dna_array (@dna_array NVARCHAR(200))
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
WITH bits AS (
  SELECT pos, TRY_CAST(value AS INT) AS v
  FROM dbo.fn_split_csv_with_index(@dna_array)
),
codes AS (
  SELECT
    signal_code        = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=1  THEN v END),
    base_qty_code      = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=2  THEN v END),
    max_legs_code      = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=3  THEN v END),
    exec_mode_code     = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=4  THEN v END),
    exec_value_code    = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=5  THEN v END),
    stagger_type_code  = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=6  THEN v END),
    stagger_value_code = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=7  THEN v END),
    tp_code            = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=8  THEN v END),
    sl_code            = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=9  THEN v END),
    trailing_mode_code = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=10 THEN v END),
    trailing_value_code= MAX(CASE WHEN pos=11 THEN v END),
    profit_protect_code= MAX(CASE WHEN pos=12 THEN v END),
    pp_trigger_code    = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=13 THEN v END),
    pp_lock_code       = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=14 THEN v END),
    exit_rule_code     = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=15 THEN v END),
    exit_value_code    = MAX(CASE WHEN pos=16 THEN v END)
  FROM bits
)
SELECT
  -- core
  side_pref = CASE signal_code WHEN 1 THEN 'BUY' WHEN 2 THEN 'SELL' ELSE 'BOTH' END,
  leg_qty   = CASE base_qty_code
                WHEN 1 THEN 30000 WHEN 2 THEN 40000 WHEN 3 THEN 50000
                WHEN 4 THEN 60000 WHEN 5 THEN 75000 WHEN 6 THEN 100000 END,
  max_legs  = CASE max_legs_code WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,

  -- execution
  exec_mode = CASE exec_mode_code
                WHEN 1 THEN 'every_minutes' WHEN 2 THEN 'price_move'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'clock_bucket' ELSE 'event_gate' END,
  every_minutes   = CASE WHEN exec_mode_code=1
                         THEN CASE exec_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 5 WHEN 5 THEN 10 END END,
  price_move_pips = CASE WHEN exec_mode_code=2
                         THEN CASE exec_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 10 WHEN 4 THEN 15 WHEN 5 THEN 20 END END,

  -- stagger
  stagger_type = CASE stagger_type_code WHEN 0 THEN 'none' WHEN 1 THEN 'time' ELSE 'price' END,
  stagger_seconds = CASE WHEN stagger_type_code=1
                         THEN CASE stagger_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 60 WHEN 3 THEN 120 WHEN 4 THEN 180 END END,
  stagger_pips    = CASE WHEN stagger_type_code=2
                         THEN CASE stagger_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 10 END END,

  -- targets
  tp_pips = CASE tp_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 12 WHEN 5 THEN 16 WHEN 6 THEN 20 END,
  sl_pips = CASE sl_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 12 WHEN 4 THEN 18 WHEN 5 THEN 25 END,

  -- trailing
  trailing_mode = CASE trailing_mode_code WHEN 0 THEN 'off' WHEN 1 THEN 'percent' ELSE 'pips' END,
  trailing_percent = CASE WHEN trailing_mode_code=1
                          THEN CASE trailing_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 40 WHEN 3 THEN 50 WHEN 4 THEN 60 WHEN 5 THEN 70 WHEN 6 THEN 80 END END,
  trailing_pips    = CASE WHEN trailing_mode_code=2
                          THEN CASE trailing_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 10 END END,

  -- profit protection
  profit_protect_enabled = CASE profit_protect_code WHEN 1 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT) ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT) END,
  pp_trigger_pips = CASE WHEN profit_protect_code=1
                         THEN CASE pp_trigger_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 10 WHEN 4 THEN 12 WHEN 5 THEN 15 END END,
  pp_lock_percent = CASE WHEN profit_protect_code=1
                         THEN CASE pp_lock_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 40 WHEN 3 THEN 50 WHEN 4 THEN 60 WHEN 5 THEN 70 END END,

  -- exit
  exit_rule = CASE exit_rule_code WHEN 0 THEN 'none' WHEN 1 THEN 'max_duration' WHEN 2 THEN 'flip' ELSE 'breakeven_then_tp_sl' END,
  max_duration_min       = CASE WHEN exit_rule_code=1
                                THEN CASE exit_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 60 WHEN 3 THEN 90 END END,
  breakeven_trigger_pips = CASE WHEN exit_rule_code=3
                                THEN CASE exit_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 END END
FROM codes;

routines.name: fn_decode_dna_json
routines.definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION dbo.fn_decode_dna_json(@dna_json NVARCHAR(MAX))
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
WITH j AS (
  SELECT
    side_pref              = COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.signal'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.side_pref')),
    leg_qty                = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.leg_qty'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.base_qty')) AS INT),
    max_legs               = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.max_legs'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.max_legs_code')) AS INT),

    exec_mode              = COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.execute.mode'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.execute_mode')),
    exec_value_code        = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.execute.value_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.execute_value_code')) AS INT),

    stagger_type           = COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.stagger.type'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.stagger_type')),
    stagger_value_code     = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.stagger.value_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.stagger_value_code')) AS INT),

    tp_code                = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.targets.tp_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.tp_code')) AS INT),
    sl_code                = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.targets.sl_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.sl_code')) AS INT),

    trailing_mode          = COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.trailing.mode'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.trailing_mode')),
    trailing_value_code    = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.trailing.value_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.trailing_value_code')) AS INT),

    profit_protect_enabled = CASE
                                WHEN COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect.enabled'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect_enabled')) IN ('1','true','TRUE') THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
                                WHEN COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect.enabled'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect_enabled')) IN ('0','false','FALSE') THEN CAST(0 AS BIT)
                                ELSE TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect.enabled'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect_enabled')) AS BIT)
                              END,
    pp_trigger_code        = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect.trigger_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.pp_trigger_code')) AS INT),
    pp_lock_code           = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.profit_protect.lock_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.pp_lock_code')) AS INT),

    exit_rule              = COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.exit.rule'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.exit_rule')),
    exit_value_code        = TRY_CAST(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.exit.value_code'), JSON_VALUE(@dna_json,'$.exit_value_code')) AS INT)
)
SELECT
  -- core
  j.side_pref,
  j.leg_qty,
  j.max_legs,
  j.exec_mode,
  j.stagger_type,
  j.trailing_mode,
  j.profit_protect_enabled,
  j.exit_rule,

  -- resolved execution
  every_minutes   = CASE WHEN j.exec_mode='every_minutes'
                         THEN CASE j.exec_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 5 WHEN 5 THEN 10 END END,
  price_move_pips = CASE WHEN j.exec_mode='price_move'
                         THEN CASE j.exec_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 10 WHEN 4 THEN 15 WHEN 5 THEN 20 END END,

  -- resolved stagger
  stagger_seconds = CASE WHEN j.stagger_type='time'
                         THEN CASE j.stagger_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 60 WHEN 3 THEN 120 WHEN 4 THEN 180 END END,
  stagger_pips    = CASE WHEN j.stagger_type='price'
                         THEN CASE j.stagger_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 10 END END,

  -- targets
  tp_pips         = CASE j.tp_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 12 WHEN 5 THEN 16 WHEN 6 THEN 20 END,
  sl_pips         = CASE j.sl_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 12 WHEN 4 THEN 18 WHEN 5 THEN 25 END,

  -- trailing
  trailing_percent= CASE WHEN j.trailing_mode='percent'
                         THEN CASE j.trailing_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 40 WHEN 3 THEN 50 WHEN 4 THEN 60 WHEN 5 THEN 70 WHEN 6 THEN 80 END END,
  trailing_pips   = CASE WHEN j.trailing_mode='pips'
                         THEN CASE j.trailing_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 WHEN 4 THEN 10 END END,

  -- profit protection
  pp_trigger_pips = CASE WHEN j.profit_protect_enabled=1
                         THEN CASE j.pp_trigger_code WHEN 1 THEN 5 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 10 WHEN 4 THEN 12 WHEN 5 THEN 15 END END,
  pp_lock_percent = CASE WHEN j.profit_protect_enabled=1
                         THEN CASE j.pp_lock_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 40 WHEN 3 THEN 50 WHEN 4 THEN 60 WHEN 5 THEN 70 END END,

  -- exit extras
  max_duration_min       = CASE WHEN j.exit_rule='max_duration'
                                THEN CASE j.exit_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 30 WHEN 2 THEN 60 WHEN 3 THEN 90 END END,
  breakeven_trigger_pips = CASE WHEN j.exit_rule='breakeven_then_tp_sl'
                                THEN CASE j.exit_value_code WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 8 END END
FROM j;

routines.name: fn_expand_trade_legs
routines.definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION dbo.fn_expand_trade_legs
(
    @product NVARCHAR(50),
    @signal  NVARCHAR(10)
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        product_upper = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@product, '')))),
        suffix        = CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@product, '')) >= 2 THEN LOWER(RIGHT(@product, 2)) ELSE '' END,
        signal_upper  = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@signal, ''))))
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        product_upper,
        suffix,
        base_product = CASE WHEN suffix IN ('_c','_s') AND LEN(product_upper) > 2 THEN LEFT(product_upper, LEN(product_upper) - 2) ELSE product_upper END,
        signal_norm  = CASE
                          WHEN signal_upper IN ('B','BUY') THEN 'BUY'
                          WHEN signal_upper IN ('S','SELL') THEN 'SELL'
                          ELSE signal_upper
                       END
    FROM normalized
),
legs_raw AS (
    SELECT
        1 AS leg_index,
        CASE WHEN LEN(base_product) >= 3 THEN SUBSTRING(base_product, 1, 3) ELSE base_product END AS leg_symbol,
        signal_norm AS leg_signal
    FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        2,
        CASE WHEN suffix IN ('_c','_s') AND LEN(base_product) >= 6 THEN SUBSTRING(base_product, 4, 3) ELSE NULL END,
        CASE
            WHEN suffix = '_s' AND signal_norm = 'BUY'  THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN suffix = '_s' AND signal_norm = 'SELL' THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE signal_norm
        END
    FROM base
),
legs AS (
    SELECT
        leg_index,
        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(leg_symbol))) AS leg_symbol,
        leg_signal
    FROM legs_raw
    WHERE leg_symbol IS NOT NULL AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(leg_symbol))) > 0
)
SELECT
    l.leg_index,
    COALESCE(meta.symbol, l.leg_symbol) AS export_symbol,
    CASE
        WHEN l.leg_signal IN ('B','BUY')   THEN 'BUY'
        WHEN l.leg_signal IN ('S','SELL') THEN 'SELL'
        ELSE l.leg_signal
    END AS export_signal,
    COALESCE(meta.secType,  'CASH')     AS secType,
    COALESCE(meta.currency, 'USD')      AS currency,
    COALESCE(meta.exchange, 'IDEALPRO') AS exchange
FROM base b
JOIN legs l ON 1 = 1
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
        fp.symbol,
        fp.secType,
        fp.currency,
        fp.exchange,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = b.product_upper THEN 0
            WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = b.base_product   THEN 1
            WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = l.leg_symbol     THEN 2
            WHEN UPPER(fp.symbol) = l.leg_symbol                         THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END AS priority_order
    FROM dbo.forex_products fp
    WHERE (fp.system_product IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(fp.system_product) IN (b.product_upper, b.base_product, l.leg_symbol))
       OR (fp.symbol IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(fp.symbol) = l.leg_symbol)
    ORDER BY priority_order
) meta;

routines.name: fn_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
routines.definition:
/*=======================================================================
  Function: dbo.fn_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
  Purpose : Return one JSON document per timestamp **for the date passed**
            (compares CAST(current_datetime AS date) to @forDate)
  Call    : SELECT * FROM dbo.fn_ForexPriceHistory_JSON('2025-06-04');
=======================================================================*/
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
(
    @forDate date   -- YYYY-MM-DD
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/
WITH raw AS (        -- 1) split + ordinal
    SELECT  f.current_datetime,
            s.value                           AS token,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY f.current_datetime
                ORDER BY (SELECT 1)
            )                                 AS seq
    FROM  dbo.forex_price_history AS f
    CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(f.current_prices, ',') AS s
    WHERE CAST(f.current_datetime AS date) = @forDate
),
pairs AS (           -- 2) key token + next token (value)
    SELECT  r1.current_datetime,
            key_token = r1.token,
            val_token = r2.token
    FROM   raw r1
    LEFT  JOIN raw r2
           ON  r2.current_datetime = r1.current_datetime
           AND r2.seq              = r1.seq + 1
    WHERE  r1.seq % 2 = 1
),
parsed AS (          -- 3) product / side / numeric price
    SELECT  current_datetime,
            product = LEFT(key_token, CHARINDEX('_',key_token)-1),
            side    = SUBSTRING(key_token,
                                 CHARINDEX('_',key_token)+1,
                                 LEN(key_token)),
            price   = TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,6), val_token)
    FROM   pairs
    WHERE  CHARINDEX('_', key_token) > 0
      AND  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,6), val_token) IS NOT NULL
),
tidy AS (            -- 4) pivot bid & ask
    SELECT  current_datetime,
            product,
            bid = MAX(CASE WHEN side='bid' THEN price END),
            ask = MAX(CASE WHEN side='ask' THEN price END)
    FROM   parsed
    GROUP BY current_datetime, product
),
jfrag AS (           -- 5) JSON fragments
    SELECT  current_datetime,
            json_piece =
      ',"' + product + '":{' +
          CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL
               THEN '"bid":' + LTRIM(STR(bid,18,6)) END +
          CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL AND ask IS NOT NULL
               THEN ',' END +
          CASE WHEN ask IS NOT NULL
               THEN '"ask":' + LTRIM(STR(ask,18,6)) END +
      '}'
    FROM   tidy
    WHERE  bid IS NOT NULL OR ask IS NOT NULL
)
/* 6) assemble JSON per timestamp */
SELECT
    '{ "current_datetime":"' +
        CONVERT(varchar(33), current_datetime, 127) + '"' +
        STUFF((
                SELECT jf.json_piece
                FROM   jfrag jf
                WHERE  jf.current_datetime = j.current_datetime
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
             ).value('.','nvarchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') +
    ' }' AS json_out
FROM jfrag j
GROUP BY current_datetime;
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------*/

routines.definition:
-- 1. Inline TVF to replace sp_9002_CheckTradeSignalForClosure logic
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_GetSignalChangeClosures
(
    @OpenTradeGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Model         VARCHAR(50),
    @IncomingSignal VARCHAR(10)
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    -- Implements the same logic as sp_9002_CheckTradeSignalForClosure
    SELECT
        o.guid,
        CASE
            -- Only consider if the open trade is tradeable
            WHEN o.tradeable = 1
             -- Condition 1: Last closed signal matches incoming and last return was negative
             AND ctc.signal = @IncomingSignal
             AND ctc.alt_net_return < 0.0
            THEN 1
            -- Condition 2: Last closed signal differs and last return was positive
            WHEN o.tradeable = 1
             AND ctc.signal <> @IncomingSignal
             AND ctc.alt_net_return > 0.0
            THEN 1
            -- Otherwise, not OK to close
            ELSE 0
        END AS CloseTrade
    FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS o
    -- join to the most recent closed trade for this model
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            ctc.signal,
            ctc.alt_net_return
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed AS ctc
        WHERE ctc.model = @Model
        ORDER BY ctc.last_update DESC
    ) AS ctc
    WHERE o.guid = @OpenTradeGuid
      AND o.model = @Model
      AND o.signal = @IncomingSignal
);

routines.name: fn_GetSignalChangeClosures_new
routines.definition:
create   FUNCTION dbo.fn_GetSignalChangeClosures_new
(
    @OpenTradeGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Model         VARCHAR(50),
    @IncomingSignal VARCHAR(10)
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
        o.guid,
        CASE
            WHEN o.tradeable = 1
             AND ctc.signal = @IncomingSignal
             AND ctc.alt_net_return < 0.0
            THEN 1
            WHEN o.tradeable = 1
             AND ctc.signal <> @IncomingSignal
             AND ctc.alt_net_return > 0.0
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS CloseTrade
    FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS o
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            ctc.signal,
            ctc.alt_net_return
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed AS ctc
        WHERE ctc.model = @Model
        ORDER BY ctc.last_update DESC
    ) AS ctc
    WHERE o.guid = @OpenTradeGuid
      AND o.model = @Model
      AND o.signal = @IncomingSignal
);

-- Optional session: 0=Asia(00–07), 1=London(08–15), 2=NY(16–23)
CREATE   FUNCTION dbo.fn_700_session (@ts DATETIME2(3))
RETURNS SMALLINT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @h INT = DATEPART(HOUR, @ts);
  RETURN CASE WHEN @h BETWEEN 0 AND 7  THEN 0
              WHEN @h BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN 1
              ELSE 2 END;
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_diagramobjects() 
	RETURNS int
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		declare @id_upgraddiagrams		int
		declare @id_sysdiagrams			int
		declare @id_helpdiagrams		int
		declare @id_helpdiagramdefinition	int

		declare @id_renamediagram	int
		declare @id_alterdiagram 	int 
		declare @id_dropdiagram		int
		declare @InstalledObjects	int

		select @InstalledObjects = 0

		select 	@id_upgraddiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams'),
			@id_sysdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sysdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagramdefinition = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition'),
			@id_creatediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_creatediagram'),
			@id_renamediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_renamediagram'),
			@id_alterdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_alterdiagram'), 
			@id_dropdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_dropdiagram')

		if @id_upgraddiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 1
		if @id_sysdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 2
		if @id_helpdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 4
		if @id_helpdiagramdefinition is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 8
		if @id_creatediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 16
		if @id_renamediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 32
		if @id_alterdiagram  is not null

			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 128
		
		return @InstalledObjects 
	END

-- ============================================================================
-- Procedure: dbo.sp_000_import_crypto_prices
-- Version:   v20260913_2355
-- Date:      2026-09-13 23:55:00
-- Reference: workstream/200_inprogress/20260913_235500_breakout_997_crypto_prices_json_import.md
-- Desc:     Ingests live crypto quotes from Z:\algo_forex\prices\crypto_prices.json
--           directly into dbo.crypto_quotes using OPENROWSET and OPENJSON.
-- ============================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_000_import_crypto_prices]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @json NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- 1. Load JSON file contents
    SELECT @json = BulkColumn
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK N'Z:\algo_forex\prices\crypto_prices.json',
        SINGLE_CLOB
    ) AS j;

    IF @json IS NULL OR LEN(@json) = 0
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR(N'crypto_prices.json is empty or could not be read.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 2. Ensure destination table exists
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.crypto_quotes', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.crypto_quotes (
            id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
            timestamp DATETIME2(7) NOT NULL,
            code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
            type CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('C'),
            bid DECIMAL(18,8) NULL,
            ask DECIMAL(18,8) NULL,
            volume DECIMAL(18,4) NULL,
            provider VARCHAR(20) NULL
        );
    END;

    -- 3. Clear existing live quotes
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.crypto_quotes;

    -- 4. Shred JSON into dbo.crypto_quotes
    INSERT INTO dbo.crypto_quotes (timestamp, code, type, bid, ask, provider)
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.timestamp') AS DATETIME2(7)) AS [timestamp],
        jq.[key] AS code,
        'C' AS type,
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.bid') AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS bid,
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.ask') AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS ask,
        ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.source'), 'binance_bookticker') AS provider
    FROM OPENJSON(@json, '$.crypto') AS jq;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_000_LoadFxQuotesFromJson_01
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @json NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- 1. Load the entire JSON file into @json (path must be a literal)
    SELECT @json = BulkColumn
    FROM OPENROWSET(
           BULK N'Z:\algo_forex\prices\forex_prices.json',
           SINGLE_CLOB
         ) AS j;

    -- 2. Wipe out previous rows
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.fx_quotes;
    -- Or, if you need to preserve identity seed: DELETE FROM dbo.fx_quotes;

    -- 3. Shred both forex and synthetic into fx_quotes
    INSERT INTO dbo.fx_quotes (timestamp, code, type, bid, ask)
    -- Base Forex
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.timestamp') AS DATETIME2(7))      AS [timestamp],
        jq.[key]                                                      AS code,
        'F'                                                           AS type,
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.bid') AS DECIMAL(18,6))      AS bid,
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.ask') AS DECIMAL(18,6))      AS ask
    FROM OPENJSON(@json, '$.forex') AS jq

    UNION ALL

    -- Synthetic
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(@json, '$.timestamp') AS DATETIME2(7)),
        jq.[key],
        'S',
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.bid') AS DECIMAL(18,6)),
        TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(jq.value, '$.ask') AS DECIMAL(18,6))
    FROM OPENJSON(@json, '$.synthetic') AS jq;
END;
