CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_203_CaptureProductSignalSnapshot]
    @BlockSizeMinutes INT = 5,
    @ModelName VARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @BlockEndTime DATETIME;
    DECLARE @BlockStartTime DATETIME;
    DECLARE @OverallBlockLatestPrice DECIMAL(18, 5);
    DECLARE @CurrentSnapshotTime DATETIME = GETDATE();
    DECLARE @Sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BlockDataTemp') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #BlockDataTemp;

    BEGIN TRY

        IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.product_signal_snapshot', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'Table dbo.product_signal_snapshot does not exist. Creating it...';

            SET @Sql = N'
            CREATE TABLE dbo.product_signal_snapshot (
                SnapshotID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                SnapshotTimestamp DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
                Product VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
                BlockStartTime DATETIME NOT NULL,
                BlockEndTime DATETIME NOT NULL,
                BlockLatestPrice DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
                TotalBuyOpen INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveBuyOpen INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveValueBuyOpen DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL,
                AvgPriceBuyOpen DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
                TotalSellOpen INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveSellOpen INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveValueSellOpen DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL,
                AvgPriceSellOpen DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
                TotalBuyClosed INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveBuyClosed INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveValueBuyClosed DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL,
                AvgPriceBuyClosed DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
                TotalSellClosed INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveSellClosed INT NOT NULL,
                PositiveValueSellClosed DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL,
                AvgPriceSellClosed DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL
            );

            CREATE INDEX IX_product_signal_snapshot_TimeProduct
            ON dbo.product_signal_snapshot (SnapshotTimestamp DESC, Product);
            ';

            EXEC sp_executesql @Sql;

            PRINT 'Table dbo.product_signal_snapshot created successfully.';
        END

        SELECT @BlockEndTime = MAX(CombinedLastUpdate)
        FROM (
            SELECT MAX(last_update) AS CombinedLastUpdate FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
            WHERE (@ModelName IS NULL OR CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = @ModelName)
              AND CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) NOT LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
            UNION ALL
            SELECT MAX(last_update) AS CombinedLastUpdate FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed
            WHERE (@ModelName IS NULL OR CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = @ModelName)
              AND CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) NOT LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
        ) AS MaxTimeFinder
        WHERE CombinedLastUpdate IS NOT NULL;

        IF @BlockEndTime IS NULL
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'Could not determine BlockEndTime. No matching trades found. No snapshot taken.';
             IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BlockDataTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BlockDataTemp;
            RETURN 0;
        END
        SET @BlockStartTime = DATEADD(minute, -@BlockSizeMinutes, @BlockEndTime);

        ;WITH BlockDataCTE AS (
             SELECT 'open' AS trade_status, signal, net_return, entry_price, last_update, latest_price, product, model
             FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
             WHERE last_update >= @BlockStartTime AND last_update < @BlockEndTime
               AND (@ModelName IS NULL OR CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = @ModelName)
               AND CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) NOT LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
             UNION ALL
             SELECT 'closed' AS trade_status, signal, net_return, entry_price, last_update, latest_price, product, model
             FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed
             WHERE last_update >= @BlockStartTime AND last_update < @BlockEndTime
               AND (@ModelName IS NULL OR CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = @ModelName)
               AND CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) NOT LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
        )
        SELECT
            trade_status, signal, net_return, entry_price, last_update, latest_price,
            CAST(product AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS product, CAST(model AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS model
        INTO #BlockDataTemp
        FROM BlockDataCTE;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #BlockDataTemp)
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @OverallBlockLatestPrice = latest_price FROM #BlockDataTemp ORDER BY last_update DESC;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @OverallBlockLatestPrice = NULL;
            PRINT 'No trade data found within the calculated block window. Snapshot will contain zeros.';
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.product_signal_snapshot (
            SnapshotTimestamp, Product, BlockStartTime, BlockEndTime, BlockLatestPrice,
            TotalBuyOpen, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveValueBuyOpen, AvgPriceBuyOpen,
            TotalSellOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveValueSellOpen, AvgPriceSellOpen,
            TotalBuyClosed, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveValueBuyClosed, AvgPriceBuyClosed,
            TotalSellClosed, PositiveSellClosed, PositiveValueSellClosed, AvgPriceSellClosed
        )
        SELECT
            @CurrentSnapshotTime, product, @BlockStartTime, @BlockEndTime,
            (SELECT TOP 1 latest_price
     FROM #BlockDataTemp AS innerT
     WHERE innerT.product = outerT.product
     ORDER BY last_update DESC),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END), 0),
            AVG(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN entry_price ELSE NULL END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END), 0),
            AVG(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'open' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN entry_price ELSE NULL END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END), 0),
            AVG(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'buy' AND net_return > 0 THEN entry_price ELSE NULL END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END), 0),
            AVG(CASE WHEN trade_status = 'closed' AND LOWER(TRIM(ISNULL(signal,''))) = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN entry_price ELSE NULL END)
        FROM #BlockDataTemp as  outerT
        GROUP BY product;

        DECLARE @RowCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;
        PRINT CONCAT('Snapshot captured successfully at ', FORMAT(@CurrentSnapshotTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), '. ', @RowCount, ' product rows inserted into product_signal_snapshot.');

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BlockDataTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BlockDataTemp;
        RETURN 0;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT CONCAT('ERROR: An error occurred while capturing the snapshot. Error Number: ', ERROR_NUMBER(), ', Message: ', ERROR_MESSAGE());
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BlockDataTemp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BlockDataTemp;
        RETURN -1;
    END CATCH;

END;

routines.name: sp_203_GetCumulativeTradeProfit_table
routines.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_203_GetCumulativeTradeProfit_table]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @tryCount INT = 1;
    DECLARE @success BIT = 0;

    WHILE @tryCount <= 3 AND @success = 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 1) Set a 10-second lock timeout so SQL waits for up to 10s to acquire a lock.
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000;  -- 10,000 milliseconds = 10 seconds

            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 2) Perform the main operation
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- a) Call the other SP first.
            EXEC dbo.SP_100_AppendToProductSummaryData;

            -- b) Check if the target table exists; if yes, truncate; if not, create.
            IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit', 'U') IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                CREATE TABLE dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit
                (
                    product                         VARCHAR(50),
                    trade_date                      DATE,
                    time_block                      VARCHAR(50),
                    [trade_in_profit (buy)]         DECIMAL(18,2),
                    [trade_in_profit (sell)]        DECIMAL(18,2),
                    [avg_latest_price]              DECIMAL(18,2),
                    [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)] DECIMAL(18,2),
                    cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff DECIMAL(18,2),
                    calc_signal                     VARCHAR(10)
                );
            END;

            -- c) Insert results from the query.
            INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit
            (
                product,
                trade_date,
                time_block,
                [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                [avg_latest_price],
                [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)],
                cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff,
                calc_signal
            )
            SELECT 
                product,
                trade_date,
                time_block,
                [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                [avg_latest_price],
                [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)],
                SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                    OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
                    AS cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff,
                CASE 
                    WHEN SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                         OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) > 0 THEN 'buy'
                    WHEN SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                         OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) < 0 THEN 'sell'
                    ELSE 'neutral'
                END AS calc_signal
            FROM
            (
                SELECT TOP (1000)
                     product,
                     trade_date,
                     CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), time_block) AS time_block,
                     [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                     [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                     [avg_latest_price],
                     [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]
                FROM dbo.vwProuctSummaryData_cross_output
                ORDER BY trade_date DESC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), time_block) ASC
            ) AS sub
            ORDER BY trade_date DESC, time_block DESC;

            -- If we reach here, the operation succeeded.
            SET @success = 1;
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- 3) If we caught an error, check if it's a lock timeout (Error 1222).
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1222
            BEGIN
                IF @tryCount < 3
                BEGIN
                    -- Wait 10 seconds before trying again (for the first 2 tries).
                    WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:10';
                END
                ELSE
                BEGIN
                    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- On the 3rd failure, kill the blocking session and try one more time.
                    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    DECLARE @blocking_session_id INT;
                    SELECT @blocking_session_id = blocking_session_id
                    FROM sys.dm_exec_requests
                    WHERE session_id = @@SPID;  -- The session that is currently blocked

                    IF @blocking_session_id IS NOT NULL AND @blocking_session_id <> 0
                    BEGIN
                        DECLARE @killCmd NVARCHAR(50) = N'KILL ' + CAST(@blocking_session_id AS NVARCHAR(10));
                        EXEC (@killCmd);
                    END

                    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- Attempt the operation again immediately after killing.
                    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    BEGIN TRY
                        SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000;  -- again wait up to 10s for locks

                        EXEC dbo.SP_100_AppendToProductSummaryData;

                        IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit', 'U') IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit;
                        END
                        ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            CREATE TABLE dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit
                            (
                                product                         VARCHAR(50),
                                trade_date                      DATE,
                                time_block                      VARCHAR(50),
                                [trade_in_profit (buy)]         DECIMAL(18,2),
                                [trade_in_profit (sell)]        DECIMAL(18,2),
                                [avg_latest_price]              DECIMAL(18,2),
                                [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)] DECIMAL(18,2),
                                cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff DECIMAL(18,2),
                                calc_signal                     VARCHAR(10)
                            );
                        END;

                        INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_CumulativeTradeProfit
                        (
                            product,
                            trade_date,
                            time_block,
                            [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                            [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                            [avg_latest_price],
                            [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)],
                            cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff,
                            calc_signal
                        )
                        SELECT 
                            product,
                            trade_date,
                            time_block,
                            [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                            [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                            [avg_latest_price],
                            [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)],
                            SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                                OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
                                AS cumulative_trade_in_profit_diff,
                            CASE 
                                WHEN SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                                     OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) > 0 THEN 'buy'
                                WHEN SUM([trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]) 
                                     OVER (PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY time_block ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) < 0 THEN 'sell'
                                ELSE 'neutral'
                            END AS calc_signal
                        FROM
                        (
                            SELECT TOP (1000)
                                 product,
                                 trade_date,
                                 CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), time_block) AS time_block,
                                 [trade_in_profit (buy)],
                                 [trade_in_profit (sell)],
                                 [avg_latest_price],
                                 [trade_in_profit_diff (buy-sell)]
                            FROM dbo.vwProuctSummaryData_cross_output
                            ORDER BY trade_date DESC, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), time_block) ASC
                        ) AS sub
                        ORDER BY trade_date DESC, time_block DESC;

                        -- If we get here, we've succeeded after killing the blocker.
                        SET @success = 1;
                        BREAK;  -- Exit the loop.
                    END TRY
                    BEGIN CATCH
                        -- Even after killing the blocker, if we still fail with 1222 or another error, raise it.
                        RAISERROR(
                            'Operation still blocked or failed even after killing the blocking session.',
                            16, 1
                        );
                        RETURN;
                    END CATCH;
                END
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- If it's some other error, rethrow and stop.
                DECLARE @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
                RAISERROR(@ErrMsg, 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH;

        SET @tryCount += 1;
    END;  -- WHILE

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- If we never succeeded after 3 tries (plus kill logic), raise a final error.
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @success = 0
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Operation failed after multiple attempts and kill logic.', 16, 1);
    END;
END;

routines.name: sp_300_UpdateAltNetGroup
routines.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:      Created from existing script
-- Create date: 2025-04-01
-- Description: Updates alt_net_group table with the latest snapshot of aggregated trading data
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_300_UpdateAltNetGroup
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- Create the alt_net_group table if it doesn't exist
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.alt_net_group', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.alt_net_group (
            alt_net_group_id      INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, -- Added a primary key
            update_time           DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL,
            product               NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            model                 NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            signal                NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
            linked                INT NOT NULL,
            net_return            DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            alt_net_return        DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            target_profit         DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            target_loss           DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            pos_net_return        INT NULL,
            pos_alt_net_return    INT NULL,
            percent_profit_target DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            percent_loss_target   DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            latest_price          DECIMAL(18, 5) NULL,
            buy_count             INT NULL,
            sell_count            INT NULL,
            diff_count            INT NULL
        );

        -- Optional: Add indexes for performance, especially on columns used for joining/filtering
        CREATE INDEX IX_alt_net_group_UpdateTime ON dbo.alt_net_group (update_time DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IX_alt_net_group_ProductModel ON dbo.alt_net_group (product, model);
        CREATE INDEX IX_alt_net_group_ProductLinked ON dbo.alt_net_group (product, linked);

        PRINT 'Table dbo.alt_net_group created.';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT 'Table dbo.alt_net_group already exists.';
    END

    -- Insert the latest snapshot of aggregated data
    -- Use Common Table Expressions (CTEs) to structure the logic

    ;WITH CTE_CombinedData AS (
        -- Combine all open trades with *linked* closed trades
        SELECT
            CAST(product AS VARCHAR(50)) AS product,
            CAST(model AS VARCHAR(50)) AS model,
            CAST(signal AS VARCHAR(10)) AS signal,
            linked,
            CAST(net_return AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS net_return, -- Ensure correct data type
            CAST(alt_net_return AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS alt_net_return,
            CAST(target_profit AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS target_profit,
            CAST(target_loss AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS target_loss,
            CAST(latest_price AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS latest_price,
            last_update -- Assuming this column exists for ordering latest price
        FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            CAST(product AS VARCHAR(50)) AS product,
            CAST(model AS VARCHAR(50)) AS model,
            CAST(signal AS VARCHAR(10)) AS signal,
            linked,
            CAST(net_return AS DECIMAL(18, 5)),
            CAST(alt_net_return AS DECIMAL(18, 5)),
            CAST(target_profit AS DECIMAL(18, 5)),
            CAST(target_loss AS DECIMAL(18, 5)),
            CAST(latest_price AS DECIMAL(18, 5)),
            last_update -- Assuming this column exists
        FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed
        WHERE linked <> 0 -- Filter for linked trades only in closed view
    ),
    CTE_GroupedAggregates AS (
        -- Perform the core grouping and aggregation
        SELECT
            product,
            model,
            signal,
            linked,
            SUM(net_return) AS sum_net_return,
            SUM(alt_net_return) AS sum_alt_net_return,
            SUM(target_profit) AS sum_target_profit,
            SUM(target_loss) AS sum_target_loss,
            -- Count trades with positive returns within the group
            SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_pos_net_return,
            SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_pos_alt_net_return
        FROM CTE_CombinedData
        GROUP BY
            product, -- Already cast to VARCHAR(50) in the SELECT
            model,   -- Already cast to VARCHAR(50) in the SELECT
            signal,  -- Already cast to VARCHAR(10) in the SELECT
            linked
    ),
    CTE_LatestPrice AS (
        -- Find the latest price per product/linked combination from the combined data
        SELECT
            product,
            linked,
            latest_price,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product, linked ORDER BY last_update DESC) as rn
        FROM CTE_CombinedData
        WHERE latest_price IS NOT NULL -- Exclude null prices if they don't make sense
    ),
    CTE_OpenUnlinkedCounts AS (
         -- Count *open* and *unlinked* trades grouped by product/model
        SELECT
            CAST(product AS VARCHAR(50)) AS product,
            CAST(model AS VARCHAR(50)) AS model,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as buy_count,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sell_count
        FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_open
        WHERE linked = 0 -- Filter for unlinked trades only
        GROUP BY
            CAST(product AS VARCHAR(50)),
            CAST(model AS VARCHAR(50))
    )
    -- Final INSERT statement combining data from CTEs
    INSERT INTO dbo.alt_net_group (
        update_time,
        product,
        model,
        signal,
        linked,
        net_return,
        alt_net_return,
        target_profit,
        target_loss,
        pos_net_return,
        pos_alt_net_return,
        percent_profit_target,
        percent_loss_target,
        latest_price,
        buy_count,
        sell_count,
        diff_count
    )
    SELECT
        GETDATE() AS update_time, -- Current timestamp for this snapshot
        agg.product,
        agg.model,
        agg.signal,
        agg.linked,
        agg.sum_net_return,
        agg.sum_alt_net_return,
        agg.sum_target_profit,
        agg.sum_target_loss,
        agg.count_pos_net_return,
        agg.count_pos_alt_net_return,

        -- Calculate percent_profit_target (handle division by zero)
        CASE
            WHEN agg.sum_net_return > 0 AND ISNULL(agg.sum_target_profit, 0) <> 0 -- Use NULLIF for safer division by zero check
            THEN (agg.sum_net_return / NULLIF(agg.sum_target_profit, 0)) * 100.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS percent_profit_target,

        -- Calculate percent_loss_target (handle division by zero)
        CASE
            WHEN agg.sum_net_return < 0 AND ISNULL(agg.sum_target_loss, 0) > 0 -- Ensure target loss is positive before dividing
            THEN (agg.sum_net_return / NULLIF(agg.sum_target_loss, 0)) * 100.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS percent_loss_target,

        lp.latest_price,

        ISNULL(ouc.buy_count, 0) AS buy_count, -- Use ISNULL in case a product/model has no open unlinked trades
        ISNULL(ouc.sell_count, 0) AS sell_count,
        ISNULL(ouc.buy_count, 0) - ISNULL(ouc.sell_count, 0) AS diff_count

    FROM CTE_GroupedAggregates agg
    LEFT JOIN CTE_LatestPrice lp ON CAST(agg.product AS VARCHAR(50)) = CAST(lp.product AS VARCHAR(50)) AND agg.linked = lp.linked AND lp.rn = 1 -- Join latest price
    LEFT JOIN CTE_OpenUnlinkedCounts ouc ON CAST(agg.product AS VARCHAR(50)) = CAST(ouc.product AS VARCHAR(50)) AND CAST(agg.model AS VARCHAR(50)) = CAST(ouc.model AS VARCHAR(50)) -- Join open unlinked counts
    ORDER BY
        CAST(agg.product AS VARCHAR(50)), 
        CAST(agg.model AS VARCHAR(50)), 
        CAST(agg.signal AS VARCHAR(10)), 
        agg.linked; -- Cast text fields to prevent issues with text/ntext comparison

    PRINT 'Snapshot inserted into dbo.alt_net_group.';
END

routines.name: sp_352_set_tradeable_for_specific_trades
routines.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_352_set_tradeable_for_specific_trades]
    @use_signal_index_filter     BIT = 1,
    @use_post_loss_filter        BIT = 1,
    @use_top_performer_filter    BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) Price‐tolerance
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @price_tolerance DECIMAL(18,6) = 0.0001;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Latest tradepoint & tradezone (from the _signal_ view)
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @tradepoint NVARCHAR(255),
            @tradezone  NVARCHAR(255);

    SELECT TOP 1
        @tradepoint = tradepoint,
        @tradezone  = tradezone
    FROM dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal
    ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC, SnapshotID DESC;

    IF @tradepoint IS NULL AND @tradezone IS NULL
        RETURN;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) Tradeable‐model config
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @TradeableModels TABLE
    (
        model           NVARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
        mapto_tradezone BIT,
        use_trade_count BIT
    );

    INSERT INTO @TradeableModels (model, mapto_tradezone, use_trade_count)
    SELECT model, mapto_tradezone, use_trade_count
    FROM dbo.product_forex
    WHERE tradeable = 1;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) Top‐performer setup
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @TopPerformer TABLE
    (
        model                       INT,
        signal                      NVARCHAR(255),
        product                     NVARCHAR(255),
        avg_profitable_entry_price  DECIMAL(18,6),
        avg_profitable_latest_price DECIMAL(18,6)
    );

    IF @use_top_performer_filter = 1
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @TopPerformer
        (
            model, signal, product,
            avg_profitable_entry_price,
            avg_profitable_latest_price
        )
        SELECT model, signal, product,
               avg_profitable_entry_price,
               avg_profitable_latest_price
        FROM
        (
            SELECT v.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() 
                     OVER (PARTITION BY v.product
                           ORDER BY v.profitable_percent DESC,
                                    v.total_return       DESC
                           ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.vw_106_ModelPerformance_alt AS v
        ) AS ranked
        WHERE rn = 1;
    END

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) Find the most‐recent dormant trade per model/signal
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @GuidsToUpdate TABLE (guid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER PRIMARY KEY);

    ;WITH MostRecentDormant AS
    (
        SELECT 
            o.guid,
            o.model,
            o.signal,
            o.product,
            ROW_NUMBER() 
              OVER (PARTITION BY o.model, o.signal 
                    ORDER BY o.created DESC
                   ) AS rn,
            tm.mapto_tradezone,
            tm.use_trade_count,
            -- get the index from the *non-signal* view
            bs.BuySellIndex,
            ss.BidPrice,
            ss.AskPrice,
            ss.mid_price,
            lc.signal  AS last_closed_signal,
            lc.created AS last_closed_created
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS o
        JOIN @TradeableModels AS tm 
          ON tm.model = o.model

        -- Pull the latest BuySellIndex from the plain tradepoint view:
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 v.BuySellIndex
            FROM dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint AS v
            WHERE v.Product = o.product
            ORDER BY v.SnapshotTimestamp DESC, v.SnapshotID DESC
        ) AS bs

        -- Pull the latest bid/ask unpivoted:
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                fx.bid    AS BidPrice,
                fx.ask    AS AskPrice,
                (fx.bid + fx.ask) / 2.0 AS mid_price
            FROM dbo.vw_000_forex_price_split AS v
            CROSS APPLY
            (
                VALUES
                  ('GBP', v.gbp_bid, v.gbp_ask),
                  ('EUR', v.eur_bid, v.eur_ask),
                  ('AUD', v.aud_bid, v.aud_ask),
                  ('NZD', v.nzd_bid, v.nzd_ask),
                  ('CAD', v.cad_bid, v.cad_ask),
                  ('CHF', v.chf_bid, v.chf_ask)
                  -- append more (code, bid, ask) tuples if you add currencies
            ) AS fx(currency_code, bid, ask)
            WHERE fx.currency_code = o.product
            ORDER BY v.current_datetime DESC
        ) AS ss

        -- Last losing‐but‐recovered signal
        OUTER APPLY 
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 c.signal, c.created
            FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed AS c
            WHERE c.model = o.model
              AND c.net_return < 0
              AND c.alt_net_return > 0
            ORDER BY c.created DESC
        ) AS lc

        WHERE
            o.tradeable = 0
            AND NOT EXISTS 
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS c2
                WHERE c2.model    = o.model 
                  AND c2.signal   = o.signal 
                  AND c2.tradeable > 0
            )
            AND 
            (
                -- A) Signal/Index logic
                (
                    @use_signal_index_filter = 1
                    AND tm.use_trade_count = 0
                    AND 
                    (
                        (tm.mapto_tradezone = 1 
                         AND o.signal = @tradezone 
                         AND (bs.BuySellIndex < -100 OR bs.BuySellIndex > 100))
                     OR (tm.mapto_tradezone = 0 
                         AND o.signal = @tradepoint)
                    )
                )
                OR
                -- B) Post‐loss recovery
                (
                    @use_post_loss_filter = 1
                    AND tm.use_trade_count = 1
                    AND lc.signal IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.signal = lc.signal
                    AND o.created > lc.created
                )
                OR
                -- C) Top‐performer + price‐tolerance
                (
                    @use_top_performer_filter = 1
                    AND EXISTS 
                    (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM @TopPerformer AS tp
                        WHERE tp.model   = o.model 
                          AND tp.signal  = o.signal 
                          AND tp.product = o.product
                    )
                    AND ABS(
                        ss.mid_price
                        - (SELECT tp2.avg_profitable_entry_price
                           FROM @TopPerformer AS tp2
                           WHERE tp2.model   = o.model 
                             AND tp2.signal  = o.signal 
                             AND tp2.product = o.product
                          )
                      ) <= @price_tolerance
                )
            )
    )
    INSERT INTO @GuidsToUpdate (guid)
    SELECT guid
    FROM MostRecentDormant
    WHERE rn = 1;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5) Mark them tradeable
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE dbo.combined_trades_open
    SET tradeable = 1
    WHERE guid IN (SELECT guid FROM @GuidsToUpdate);
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_400_InsertIntoTblRtTrades]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @InsertedRows TABLE (tradeGuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);

    WITH base_trades AS (
        SELECT
            c.guid,
            c.created,
            c.product,
            c.product_type,
            c.signal,
            UPPER(c.signal) AS signal_upper,
            c.trade_quantity,
            CASE WHEN LOWER(RIGHT(c.product, 2)) IN ('_c', '_s') THEN LOWER(RIGHT(c.product, 2)) ELSE '' END AS product_suffix,
            CASE WHEN LOWER(RIGHT(c.product, 2)) IN ('_c', '_s') THEN LEFT(c.product, LEN(c.product) - 2) ELSE c.product END AS base_product
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS c
        WHERE c.tradeable = 1
    ),
    expanded_trades AS (
        SELECT
            b.guid,
            b.created,
            b.product,
            b.product_type,
            b.trade_quantity,
            b.product_suffix,
            b.base_product,
            legs.leg_index,
            legs.leg_symbol,
            legs.leg_signal
        FROM base_trades AS b
        CROSS APPLY (
            VALUES
                (1,
                 CASE WHEN b.product_suffix IN ('_c', '_s')
                      THEN UPPER(SUBSTRING(b.base_product, 1, 3))
                      ELSE UPPER(b.base_product)
                 END,
                 b.signal_upper),
                (2,
                 CASE WHEN b.product_suffix IN ('_c', '_s') AND LEN(b.base_product) >= 6
                      THEN UPPER(SUBSTRING(b.base_product, 4, 3))
                      ELSE NULL
                 END,
                 CASE WHEN b.product_suffix = '_s' AND b.signal_upper IN ('BUY', 'B') THEN 'SELL'
                      WHEN b.product_suffix = '_s' AND b.signal_upper IN ('SELL', 'S') THEN 'BUY'
                      ELSE b.signal_upper
                 END)
        ) AS legs(leg_index, leg_symbol, leg_signal)
        WHERE legs.leg_symbol IS NOT NULL
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_rt_trades (
        trade_time,
        trade_guid,
        trade_details,
        trade_status,
        execution_status,
        product_type,
        signal,
        product
    )
    OUTPUT inserted.trade_guid INTO @InsertedRows (tradeGuid)
    SELECT
        e.created,
        e.guid,
        CONCAT(
            e.leg_symbol, ',',
            ISNULL(fp_meta.secType, 'CASH'), ',',
            ISNULL(fp_meta.exchange, 'IDEALPRO'), ',',
            ISNULL(fp_meta.exchange, 'IDEALPRO'), ',',
            ISNULL(fp_meta.currency, 'USD'), ',',
            'MKT', ',',
            CAST(e.trade_quantity AS VARCHAR(50)), ',',
            e.leg_signal
        ),
        'open',
        'pending',
        e.product_type,
        e.leg_signal,
        e.leg_symbol
    FROM expanded_trades AS e
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            fp.secType,
            fp.currency,
            fp.exchange
        FROM dbo.forex_products AS fp
        WHERE UPPER(fp.symbol) = e.leg_symbol
          AND (
                UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = UPPER(e.product)
             OR UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = UPPER(e.base_product)
             OR ISNULL(fp.system_product, '') = ''
          )
        ORDER BY CASE
                    WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = UPPER(e.product) THEN 0
                    WHEN UPPER(ISNULL(fp.system_product, '')) = UPPER(e.base_product) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                 END
    ) AS fp_meta;

    UPDATE dbo.combined_trades_open
    SET tradeable = 2
    WHERE guid IN (SELECT DISTINCT tradeGuid FROM @InsertedRows);
END;

-- Create the stored procedure
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_500_UpsertPivotedGbpTradesToday
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Declare variables needed for dynamic SQL generation
    DECLARE @PivotColumns NVARCHAR(MAX);        -- For PIVOT IN (...)
    DECLARE @SelectSourceColumns NVARCHAR(MAX); -- For SELECT ... FROM PIVOT result
    DECLARE @MergeUpdateSet NVARCHAR(MAX);      -- For MERGE ... WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ...
    DECLARE @TargetInsertColumns NVARCHAR(MAX); -- For MERGE ... INSERT (...)
    DECLARE @SourceInsertColumns NVARCHAR(MAX); -- For MERGE ... VALUES (...)
    DECLARE @SQL_Pivot NVARCHAR(MAX);           -- Holds dynamic SQL for PIVOT into temp table
    DECLARE @SQL_Merge NVARCHAR(MAX);           -- Holds dynamic SQL for MERGE operation

    -- Generate the 48 time band labels and dynamic SQL components
    WITH TimeBands AS (
        SELECT TOP 48 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS IntervalID
        FROM master.dbo.spt_values n1 CROSS JOIN master.dbo.spt_values n2
    ),
    FormattedTimeBands AS (
        SELECT
            IntervalID,
            DATEADD(MINUTE, IntervalID * 30, CAST('00:00' AS TIME)) AS StartTime,
            DATEADD(MINUTE, (IntervalID + 1) * 30, CAST('00:00' AS TIME)) AS EndTime
        FROM TimeBands
    )
    SELECT
        @PivotColumns = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
        @SelectSourceColumns = STRING_AGG(N'ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ) + N', 0)', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
        @MergeUpdateSet = STRING_AGG(N'Target.' + QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ) + N' = Source.' + QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ), N', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
        @TargetInsertColumns = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
        @SourceInsertColumns = STRING_AGG(N'Source.' + QUOTENAME( TimeBandName ), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID)
    FROM (
        SELECT
            IntervalID,
            -- Generate the consistent time band name HH:mm-HH:mm
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, StartTime) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + ':' +
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, StartTime) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + '-' +
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, EndTime) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + ':' +
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, EndTime) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
            AS TimeBandName
        FROM FormattedTimeBands
    ) AS BandsWithNames;

    -- Check if dynamic column generation failed
    IF @PivotColumns IS NULL OR @SelectSourceColumns IS NULL OR @MergeUpdateSet IS NULL OR @TargetInsertColumns IS NULL OR @SourceInsertColumns IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Failed to generate dynamic time band columns for PIVOT/MERGE.', 16, 1);
        RETURN; -- Exit the procedure
    END

    -- Construct dynamic SQL to PIVOT data into a temp table #SourcePivotedData
    SET @SQL_Pivot = N'
        -- Drop temp table if it exists from a previous failed run
        IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#SourcePivotedData'') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #SourcePivotedData;

        -- CTE to get the raw data and calculate the time band for matching
        WITH TradeDataWithTimeBand AS (
            SELECT
                entry_price,
                guid, -- Column to aggregate (COUNT)
                -- Calculate the time band label (must match column generation logic)
                (
                    RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, created) / 30) * 30, 0)) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + '':'' +
                    RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, created) / 30) * 30, 0)) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + ''-'' +
                    RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(MINUTE, ((DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, created) / 30) + 1) * 30, 0)) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + '':'' +
                    RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE, ((DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, created) / 30) + 1) * 30, 0)) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
                ) AS time_band
            FROM
                [tradedb].[dbo].[combined_trades_open]
            WHERE
                product = ''gbp''
                AND CAST(created AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) -- Data for TODAY only
        )
        -- PIVOT the data and insert into the temp table
        SELECT
            entry_price,
            ' + @SelectSourceColumns + N' -- Selects the pivoted columns, handling NULLs
        INTO #SourcePivotedData -- Create and populate the temp table
        FROM
            TradeDataWithTimeBand
        PIVOT
        (
            COUNT(guid) -- Aggregate function
            FOR time_band IN (
                ' + @PivotColumns + N' -- Dynamic list of columns from time bands
            )
        ) AS PivotTable;';

    -- Construct dynamic SQL for the MERGE statement
    SET @SQL_Merge = N'
        MERGE INTO dbo.PivotedGbpTradesTodaySummary AS Target
        USING #SourcePivotedData AS Source
        ON Target.entry_price = Source.entry_price -- Match rows based on entry_price

        -- When rows match: Update all time band counts in the target table
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET ' + @MergeUpdateSet + N'

        -- When row exists in Source but not Target: Insert a new row
        WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
            INSERT (entry_price, ' + @TargetInsertColumns + N')
            VALUES (Source.entry_price, ' + @SourceInsertColumns + N')

        -- When row exists in Target but not in Source (optional but recommended for daily refresh):
        -- This handles cases where an entry_price had trades earlier today but no longer does.
        WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN
            DELETE;
            
        -- Optional: Output changes (useful for logging)
        -- OUTPUT $action, Inserted.*, Deleted.*;
        ';

    -- *** Execute the dynamic SQL statements ***
    -- 1. Create and populate the #SourcePivotedData temp table
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL_Pivot;

    -- 2. Perform the MERGE operation against the permanent table
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL_Merge;

    -- Temp table #SourcePivotedData will be dropped automatically when the session/scope ends

    PRINT 'Upsert operation complete for dbo.PivotedGbpTradesTodaySummary.';

END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_501_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
      @PivotCols  NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @SelectCols NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @UpdateSets NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @InsCols    NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @InsVals    NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @SQL        NVARCHAR(MAX);

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Build the 48 half‑hour time bands
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    WITH TimeBands AS (
        SELECT TOP(48)
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS IntervalID
        FROM master.dbo.spt_values v1
        CROSS JOIN master.dbo.spt_values v2
    ),
    Formatted AS (
        SELECT
          IntervalID,
          DATEADD(MINUTE, IntervalID*30,     CAST('00:00' AS TIME)) AS StartTime,
          DATEADD(MINUTE, (IntervalID+1)*30, CAST('00:00' AS TIME)) AS EndTime
        FROM TimeBands
    )
    SELECT
      @PivotCols  = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME(Band), ',')           WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
      @SelectCols = STRING_AGG(
                       N'ISNULL(' + QUOTENAME(Band) + N',0.0) AS ' + QUOTENAME(Band)
                     , ', ')                                     WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
      @UpdateSets = STRING_AGG(
                       N'Target.' + QUOTENAME(Band) + N' = Source.' + QUOTENAME(Band)
                     , ', ')                                     WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
      @InsCols    = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME(Band), ', ')          WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID),
      @InsVals    = STRING_AGG(N'Source.' + QUOTENAME(Band), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IntervalID)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        IntervalID,
        RIGHT('0'+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, StartTime)   AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
        + ':' +
        RIGHT('0'+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, StartTime) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
        + '-' +
        RIGHT('0'+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, EndTime)     AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
        + ':' +
        RIGHT('0'+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, EndTime)   AS VARCHAR(2)),2) AS Band
      FROM Formatted
    ) AS x;

    IF @PivotCols  IS NULL
      OR @SelectCols IS NULL
      OR @UpdateSets IS NULL
      OR @InsCols    IS NULL
      OR @InsVals    IS NULL
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('Failed to build PIVOT fragments.',16,1);
      RETURN;
    END

    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) One dynamic batch: include open + closed, pivot, merge, return
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @SQL = N'
      IF OBJECT_ID(''tempdb..#src'') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #src;

      -- combine today''s positive‐net GBP trades from open + closed
      WITH T AS (
        SELECT
          product,
          entry_price,
          signal,
          net_return,
          ( /* compute 30‑min band */ 
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR,   DATEADD(MINUTE,(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + '':'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE,(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + ''-'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR,   DATEADD(MINUTE,((DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)+1)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + '':'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE,((DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)+1)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
          ) AS time_band
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
        WHERE product = ''gbp''
          AND CAST(created AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
          AND net_return > 0

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
          product,
          entry_price,
          signal,
          net_return,
          (
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR,   DATEADD(MINUTE,(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + '':'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE,(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + ''-'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(HOUR,   DATEADD(MINUTE,((DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)+1)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
            + '':'' +
            RIGHT(''0''+CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE, DATEADD(MINUTE,((DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/30)+1)*30,0)) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
          ) AS time_band
        FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed
        WHERE product = ''gbp''
          AND CAST(created AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
          AND net_return > 0
      )

      -- pivot into #src, preserving product & signal
      SELECT
        product,
        entry_price,
        signal,
        ' + @SelectCols + N'
      INTO #src
      FROM T
      PIVOT
      (
        SUM(net_return)
        FOR time_band IN (' + @PivotCols + N')
      ) AS pvt;

      -- upsert into your summary
      MERGE dbo.PivotedGbpNetReturnTodaySummary AS Target
      USING #src AS Source
        ON Target.entry_price = Source.entry_price
       AND Target.signal      = Source.signal
      WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET ' + @UpdateSets + N'
      WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (entry_price, signal, ' + @InsCols + N')
        VALUES (Source.entry_price, Source.signal, ' + @InsVals + N')
      WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN
        DELETE;

      -- return BUY group, desc by entry_price
      SELECT
        product,
        entry_price,
        ' + @PivotCols + N'
      FROM #src
      WHERE signal = ''BUY''
      ORDER BY entry_price DESC;

      -- return SELL group, desc by entry_price
      SELECT
        product,
        entry_price,
        ' + @PivotCols + N'
      FROM #src
      WHERE signal = ''SELL''
      ORDER BY entry_price DESC;

      DROP TABLE #src;
    ';

    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;
END;

routines.name: sp_503_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday_XMin
routines.definition:
/* =========================================================================
   Name :  sp_503_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday
   Task :  Up‑sert (entry_price + signal + time_band) averages for TODAY
           – time_band width is supplied by the caller
   Example:
       EXEC dbo.sp_503_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday  @BandSizeMin = 15;   -- 15‑min bands
       EXEC dbo.sp_503_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday;                      -- default 10
   =========================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_503_UpsertPivotedGbpNetReturnToday_XMin]
    @BandSizeMin int = 10        -- minutes per band (default 10)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* -------- safety checks ------------------------------------------------- */
    IF @BandSizeMin NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 720      -- up to 12 hours; adjust if needed
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR ('@BandSizeMin must be between 1 and 720 minutes', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END

    /* -------- today’s bucketed averages ------------------------------------- */
    ;WITH DailyAverages AS
    (
        SELECT
            product,
            CAST(created AS date)                                   AS trade_date,
            entry_price,
            signal,

            /* === aligned band =================================================
               bucket     = floor(minutes since 1900‑01‑01 00:00 / @BandSizeMin)
               bandStart  = bucket * @BandSizeMin minutes from midnight
             ===================================================================*/
            FORMAT( DATEADD(MINUTE,
                            (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/@BandSizeMin)*@BandSizeMin,
                            0), 'HH:mm')
            + '-' +
            FORMAT( DATEADD(MINUTE,
                            (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/@BandSizeMin)*@BandSizeMin
                            + @BandSizeMin,
                            0), 'HH:mm')                            AS time_band,

            AVG(net_return)                                         AS avg_net_return
        FROM   dbo.combined_trades_open
        WHERE  product      = 'gbp'
          AND  created     >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
          AND  created     < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
          AND  net_return  > -99999
        GROUP BY
            product,
            CAST(created AS date),
            entry_price,
            signal,
            (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,0,created)/@BandSizeMin)               -- bucket id
    )

    /* -------- up‑sert into the columnar table ------------------------------- */
    MERGE dbo.PivotedGbpNetReturnToday_10mins_Columnar   AS T
    USING DailyAverages                                  AS S
      ON  T.trade_date  = S.trade_date
      AND T.entry_price = S.entry_price
      AND T.signal      = S.signal
      AND T.time_band   = S.time_band

    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET T.avg_net_return = S.avg_net_return

    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (trade_date, entry_price, signal, time_band, avg_net_return)
        VALUES (S.trade_date, S.entry_price, S.signal, S.time_band, S.avg_net_return);
END;

-- Create Stored Procedure to populate the ProductTradeSummary table
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_511_InsertProductTradeSummary
AS
BEGIN
    -- Insert the results into the ProductTradeSummary table (data will be appended)
    INSERT INTO dbo.ProductTradeSummary (current_datetime, product, buy_count, sell_count, bid, ask)
    SELECT 
        prices.current_datetime,
        trades.product,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN trades.signal = 'buy' THEN 1 END) AS buy_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN trades.signal = 'sell' THEN 1 END) AS sell_count,
        prices.bid,
        prices.ask
    FROM 
        [tradedb].[dbo].vwCombined_trades_open_restricted AS trades  -- Fully qualified view name
    LEFT JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            current_datetime,
            -- Extract the bid value
            CASE 
                WHEN CHARINDEX('gbp_bid', current_prices) > 0 
                THEN 
                    SUBSTRING(
                        current_prices, 
                        CHARINDEX('gbp_bid', current_prices) + 8, 
                        CHARINDEX(',', current_prices + ',', CHARINDEX('gbp_bid', current_prices) + 8) - (CHARINDEX('gbp_bid', current_prices) + 8)
                    )
                ELSE NULL 
            END AS bid,
            
            -- Extract the ask value
            CASE 
                WHEN CHARINDEX('gbp_ask', current_prices) > 0 
                THEN 
                    SUBSTRING(
                        current_prices, 
                        CHARINDEX('gbp_ask', current_prices) + 8, 
                        CHARINDEX(',', current_prices + ',', CHARINDEX('gbp_ask', current_prices) + 8) - (CHARINDEX('gbp_ask', current_prices) + 8)
                    )
                ELSE NULL 
            END AS ask
        FROM 
            [tradedb].[dbo].[forex_price]) AS prices
    ON 
        trades.product = 'gbp'  -- Ensure we are only considering 'gbp' product
    WHERE 
        trades.product = 'gbp'  -- Restrict product to 'gbp'
    GROUP BY 
        trades.product, prices.bid, prices.ask, prices.current_datetime
    ORDER BY 
        prices.current_datetime DESC; -- Ordering by the most recent timestamp
END

routines.name: sp_520_LogLatestTradeSnapshots

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_520_LogLatestTradeSnapshots
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Calculate the current 5-minute tumbling block boundary
    DECLARE @CurrentBlock DATETIME2 = DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, GETDATE()) / 5) * 5, 0);

    ;WITH LatestSignal AS
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) *
        FROM   dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal
        ORDER  BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC
    )
    MERGE INTO dbo.TradeSnapshotLog AS target
    USING (
        SELECT  s.SnapshotTimestamp,
                s.Product,
                s.PositiveBuyOpen,
                s.PositiveSellOpen,
                s.PositiveSellOpen_val,
                s.BlockLatestPrice,
                s.BuySellIndex,
                s.tradezone,
                s.tradepoint,
                t.current_datetime,
                t.buy_count,
                t.sell_count,
                t.buy_sell_diff,
                t.bid,
                t.ask,
                @CurrentBlock AS BlockTimestamp
        FROM   LatestSignal AS s
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            -- "Latest summary row *for the same product*"
            SELECT TOP (1) *
            FROM   dbo.vw_102_ProductTradeSummary
            WHERE  product = s.Product
            ORDER  BY current_datetime DESC
        ) AS t
    ) AS source
    ON target.Product = source.Product AND target.BlockTimestamp = source.BlockTimestamp
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET 
            target.SnapshotTimestamp = source.SnapshotTimestamp,
            target.PositiveBuyOpen = source.PositiveBuyOpen,
            target.PositiveSellOpen = source.PositiveSellOpen,
            target.PositiveSellOpen_val = source.PositiveSellOpen_val,
            target.BlockLatestPrice = source.BlockLatestPrice,
            target.BuySellIndex = source.BuySellIndex,
            target.tradezone = source.tradezone,
            target.tradepoint = source.tradepoint,
            target.current_datetime = source.current_datetime,
            target.buy_count = source.buy_count,
            target.sell_count = source.sell_count,
            target.buy_sell_diff = source.buy_sell_diff,
            target.bid = source.bid,
            target.ask = source.ask,
            target.LoggedAt = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (
            SnapshotTimestamp, Product,
            PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveSellOpen_val,
            BlockLatestPrice, BuySellIndex, tradezone, tradepoint,
            current_datetime, buy_count, sell_count, buy_sell_diff, bid, ask,
            BlockTimestamp, LoggedAt
        )
        VALUES (
            source.SnapshotTimestamp, source.Product,
            source.PositiveBuyOpen, source.PositiveSellOpen, source.PositiveSellOpen_val,
            source.BlockLatestPrice, source.BuySellIndex, source.tradezone, source.tradepoint,
            source.current_datetime, source.buy_count, source.sell_count, source.buy_sell_diff, source.bid, source.ask,
            source.BlockTimestamp, GETDATE()
        );
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_521_LogLatestTradeSnapshots
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Calculate the current 5-minute tumbling block boundary anchored at 2000-01-01
    DECLARE @CurrentBlock DATETIME2 = DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, '20000101', GETDATE()) / 5) * 5, '20000101');

    ;WITH LatestSignal AS
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) *
        FROM   dbo.vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal
        ORDER  BY SnapshotTimestamp DESC
    )
    MERGE INTO dbo.TradeSnapshotLog AS target
    USING (
        SELECT  s.SnapshotTimestamp,
                s.Product,
                s.PositiveBuyOpen,
                s.PositiveSellOpen,
                s.PositiveSellOpen_val,
                s.BlockLatestPrice,
                s.BuySellIndex,
                s.tradezone,
                s.tradepoint,
                t.current_datetime,
                t.buy_count,
                t.sell_count,
                t.buy_sell_diff,
                t.bid,
                t.ask,
                @CurrentBlock AS BlockTimestamp
        FROM   LatestSignal AS s
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT 
                GETDATE() AS current_datetime,
                ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_count,
                ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_count,
                ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_sell_diff,
                MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN latest_price ELSE NULL END) AS bid,
                MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN latest_price ELSE NULL END) AS ask
            FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
            WHERE product = s.Product
        ) AS t
    ) AS source
    ON target.Product = source.Product AND target.BlockTimestamp = source.BlockTimestamp
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET 
            target.SnapshotTimestamp = source.SnapshotTimestamp,
            target.PositiveBuyOpen = source.PositiveBuyOpen,
            target.PositiveSellOpen = source.PositiveSellOpen,
            target.PositiveSellOpen_val = source.PositiveSellOpen_val,
            target.BlockLatestPrice = source.BlockLatestPrice,
            target.BuySellIndex = source.BuySellIndex,
            target.tradezone = source.tradezone,
            target.tradepoint = source.tradepoint,
            target.current_datetime = source.current_datetime,
            target.buy_count = source.buy_count,
            target.sell_count = source.sell_count,
            target.buy_sell_diff = source.buy_sell_diff,
            target.bid = source.bid,
            target.ask = source.ask,
            target.LoggedAt = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (
            SnapshotTimestamp, Product,
            PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveSellOpen_val,
            BlockLatestPrice, BuySellIndex, tradezone, tradepoint,
            current_datetime, buy_count, sell_count, buy_sell_diff, bid, ask,
            BlockTimestamp, LoggedAt
        )
        VALUES (
            source.SnapshotTimestamp, source.Product,
            source.PositiveBuyOpen, source.PositiveSellOpen, source.PositiveSellOpen_val,
            source.BlockLatestPrice, source.BuySellIndex, source.tradezone, source.tradepoint,
            source.current_datetime, source.buy_count, source.sell_count, source.buy_sell_diff, source.bid, source.ask,
            source.BlockTimestamp, GETDATE()
        );
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_700_bulk_on_close_update]
  @rows dbo.tt_700_ClosedTradeTVP READONLY
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  SET XACT_ABORT ON;

  -- Hard fail if alt_net_return is missing; priors must be based on ALT only
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @rows WHERE is_closed = 1 AND alt_net_return IS NULL)
  BEGIN
    THROW 50001, 'alt_net_return is NULL in @rows; priors require alt_net_return.', 1;
  END

  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#x') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #x;

  ;WITH B AS (
    SELECT r.guid, r.product, r.signal, r.created, r.entry_price, r.last_update,
           CAST(r.alt_net_return AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS pnl,   -- ALT ONLY
           r.session, r.is_closed
    FROM @rows r
    WHERE r.is_closed = 1
  ),
  J AS (
    SELECT
      b.guid, b.product, b.signal, b.created, b.entry_price, b.last_update, b.pnl, b.session,
      l.entry_bucket  AS log_entry_bucket,
      l.time_bin      AS log_time_bin
    FROM B b
    LEFT JOIN dbo.tbl_700_open_trades_log l
      ON l.guid = b.guid
  )
  SELECT
    guid, product, signal, created, entry_price, last_update, pnl,
    entry_bucket = ISNULL(log_entry_bucket,
                    ISNULL(dbo.fn_700_choose_bucket(product, TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,10), entry_price)), 0)),
    time_bin     = ISNULL(log_time_bin,
                    ISNULL(dbo.fn_700_time_bin(created), 0)),
    session_key  = CONVERT(SMALLINT, ISNULL(session, -1))
  INTO #x
  FROM J;

  ;WITH agg AS (
    SELECT product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, session_key,
           COUNT(*) AS c,
           SUM(CASE WHEN pnl > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w,
           SUM(pnl) AS s
    FROM #x
    GROUP BY product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, session_key
  )
  MERGE dbo.tbl_700_priors AS T
  USING agg AS S
    ON  T.product=S.product AND T.signal=S.signal
    AND T.entry_bucket=S.entry_bucket AND T.time_bin=S.time_bin
    AND ISNULL(T.session, -1) = S.session_key
  WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET T.prior_count   = T.prior_count + S.c,
               T.prior_win_sum = T.prior_win_sum + S.w,
               T.prior_alt_sum = T.prior_alt_sum + S.s
  WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, session, prior_count, prior_win_sum, prior_alt_sum)
    VALUES (S.product, S.signal, S.entry_bucket, S.time_bin, NULL, S.c, S.w, S.s);
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_700_ExpectedGuids_ForDate
  @asof_date_utc date  = NULL,   -- set default inside
  @count_min     int   = 10,
  @hit_min       float = 0.55,
  @net_mean_min  float = 0.0,
  @alt_mean_min  float = 5.0
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  IF @asof_date_utc IS NULL
      SET @asof_date_utc = CONVERT(date, SYSUTCDATETIME());

  DECLARE @day_start datetime2(7) = CAST(@asof_date_utc AS datetime2(7));
  DECLARE @day_end   datetime2(7) = DATEADD(day, 1, @day_start);

  -- Clean temp tables if re-run in same session
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Cands')  IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Cands;
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OK_NET') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #OK_NET;
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OK_ALT') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #OK_ALT;
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ACTUAL') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ACTUAL;

  -- Candidates for the day (UTC) with SAME bucket/bin math as 700
  SELECT
      t.guid,
      t.product,
      t.signal,
      t.created,
      entry_bucket = dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket(t.entry_price),
      time_bin     = dbo.fn_700_time_bin(t.created)
  INTO #Cands
  FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS t
  WHERE t.created >= @day_start
    AND t.created <  @day_end;

  -- Expected by NET priors
  SELECT DISTINCT c.guid
  INTO #OK_NET
  FROM #Cands c
  JOIN dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel p
    ON p.product=c.product
   AND p.signal=c.signal
   AND p.entry_bucket=c.entry_bucket
   AND p.time_bin=c.time_bin
   AND p.return_type = N'net_return'
  WHERE p.trade_count >= @count_min
    AND p.hit_rate    >= @hit_min
    AND p.avg_return  >= @net_mean_min;

  -- Expected by ALT priors (this is the authoritative “should be selectable” set)
  SELECT DISTINCT c.guid
  INTO #OK_ALT
  FROM #Cands c
  JOIN dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel p
    ON p.product=c.product
   AND p.signal=c.signal
   AND p.entry_bucket=c.entry_bucket
   AND p.time_bin=c.time_bin
   AND p.return_type = N'alt_net_return'
  WHERE p.trade_count >= @count_min
    AND p.hit_rate    >= @hit_min
    AND p.avg_return  >= @alt_mean_min;

  -- Actually inserted as tradeable=1 today
  SELECT DISTINCT t.guid
  INTO #ACTUAL
  FROM dbo.combined_trades_open AS t
  WHERE t.created   >= @day_start
    AND t.created   <  @day_end
    AND t.tradeable <> 0;

  -- 1) CSVs (NVARCHAR(MAX) to avoid 8k truncation)
  SELECT
    expected_net_guid_csv = ISNULL(
      (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), '''' + CONVERT(varchar(36), guid) + ''''), ',') FROM #OK_NET), N''),
    expected_alt_guid_csv = ISNULL(
      (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), '''' + CONVERT(varchar(36), guid) + ''''), ',') FROM #OK_ALT), N''),
    actual_tradeable_csv  = ISNULL(
      (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), '''' + CONVERT(varchar(36), guid) + ''''), ',') FROM #ACTUAL), N'');

  -- 2) Missing: expected (ALT) but not actually tradeable=1
  SELECT guid AS missing_in_actual__should_have_been_tradeable
  FROM #OK_ALT
  EXCEPT
  SELECT guid FROM #ACTUAL;

  -- 3) Unexpected: tradeable=1 but not in ALT-expected
  SELECT guid AS unexpected_in_actual__not_in_alt_expected
  FROM #ACTUAL
  EXCEPT
  SELECT guid FROM #OK_ALT;

  SET NOCOUNT OFF;
END

routines.name: sp_700_GetSelectedGuids
routines.definition:
/* ============================================================
   ONE PROC TO RULE THEM ALL
   - Rebuilds 7d priors (nomodel)
   - Selects candidates scoped to a window (or today)
   - Returns a single row: net_guid_csv, alt_guid_csv
   - Tune params as needed; defaults mirror your current logic
   ============================================================ */
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_700_GetSelectedGuids
  @window_days   int   = 7,        -- recency scope for candidates
  @count_min     int   = 10,
  @hit_min       float = 0.55,
  @net_mean_min  float = 0.0,
  @alt_mean_min  float = 5.0,
  @today_only    bit   = 0,        -- 1 = only trades from today (UTC)
  @product       nvarchar(50) = NULL,  -- optional narrow
  @signal        nvarchar(50) = NULL   -- optional narrow
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @asof_utc datetime2 = SYSUTCDATETIME();

  /* 0) Ensure bucket function exists (idempotent) */
  IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket','FN') IS NULL
  BEGIN
    EXEC('CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket (@entry_price decimal(18,10))
          RETURNS int
          AS
          BEGIN
            RETURN CAST(FLOOR(@entry_price * 10000) AS int);
          END');
  END

  /* 1) Ensure priors table + view exist (idempotent) */
  IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel','U') IS NULL
  BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel (
      product       nvarchar(50)  NOT NULL,
      signal        nvarchar(50)  NOT NULL,
      entry_bucket  int           NOT NULL,
      time_bin      int           NOT NULL,
      return_type   nvarchar(20)  NOT NULL,   -- 'net_return' | 'alt_net_return'
      trade_count   int           NOT NULL,
      win_count     int           NOT NULL,
      loss_count    int           NOT NULL,
      return_sum    float         NOT NULL,
      avg_return    float         NOT NULL,
      hit_rate      float         NOT NULL,
      last_updated  datetime2     NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
      CONSTRAINT PK_tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel
        PRIMARY KEY (product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type)
    );
    CREATE INDEX IX_tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel_lookup
      ON dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel (product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type);
  END

  IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel','V') IS NULL
  BEGIN
    EXEC('CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel AS SELECT * FROM dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel;');
  END

  /* 2) Rebuild priors (uses the last @window_days of CLOSED trades) */
  BEGIN TRAN;

    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel;

    ;WITH Base AS (
      SELECT
        t.product,
        t.signal,
        entry_bucket = dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket(t.entry_price),
        time_bin     = dbo.fn_700_time_bin(t.created),  -- existing 1-arg fn
        t.net_return,
        t.alt_net_return
      FROM dbo.vwCombined_trades_closed AS t
      WHERE t.created >= DATEADD(day, -@window_days, @asof_utc)
        AND (@product IS NULL OR t.product = @product)
        AND (@signal  IS NULL OR t.signal  = @signal)
    ),
    Unpiv AS (
      SELECT product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, 'net_return'     AS return_type, CAST(net_return     AS float) AS return_value FROM Base
      UNION ALL
      SELECT product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, 'alt_net_return' AS return_type, CAST(alt_net_return AS float) AS return_value FROM Base
    ),
    Agg AS (
      SELECT
        product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type,
        trade_count = COUNT(*),
        win_count   = SUM(CASE WHEN return_value > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        loss_count  = SUM(CASE WHEN return_value <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        return_sum  = SUM(return_value)
      FROM Unpiv
      GROUP BY product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_700_priors_7d_nomodel
      (product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type,
       trade_count, win_count, loss_count, return_sum, avg_return, hit_rate, last_updated)
    SELECT
      product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, return_type,
      trade_count, win_count, loss_count, return_sum,
      avg_return = return_sum / NULLIF(CAST(trade_count AS float), 0),
      hit_rate   = CAST(win_count AS float) / NULLIF(CAST(trade_count AS float), 0),
      SYSUTCDATETIME()
    FROM Agg;

  COMMIT;

  /* 3) Candidate scope (recent or today, and optional product/signal) */
  ;WITH Cands AS (
    SELECT
      t.guid,
      t.product,
      t.signal,
      t.created,
      entry_bucket = dbo.fn_700_entry_bucket(t.entry_price),
      time_bin     = dbo.fn_700_time_bin(t.created)
    FROM dbo.vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS t
    WHERE
      (
        @today_only = 1 AND CONVERT(date, t.created) = CONVERT(date, @asof_utc)
      )
      OR
      (
        @today_only = 0 AND t.created >= DATEADD(day, -@window_days, @asof_utc)
      )
      AND (@product IS NULL OR t.product = @product)
      AND (@signal  IS NULL OR t.signal  = @signal)
  ),
  OK_NET AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.guid
    FROM Cands c
    JOIN dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel p
      ON p.product=c.product
     AND p.signal=c.signal
     AND p.entry_bucket=c.entry_bucket
     AND p.time_bin=c.time_bin
     AND p.return_type = N'net_return'
    WHERE p.trade_count >= @count_min
      AND p.hit_rate    >= @hit_min
      AND p.avg_return  >= @net_mean_min
  ),
  OK_ALT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.guid
    FROM Cands c
    JOIN dbo.vw_700_priors_nomodel p
      ON p.product=c.product
     AND p.signal=c.signal
     AND p.entry_bucket=c.entry_bucket
     AND p.time_bin=c.time_bin
     AND p.return_type = N'alt_net_return'
    WHERE p.trade_count >= @count_min
      AND p.hit_rate    >= @hit_min
      AND p.avg_return  >= @alt_mean_min
  )
  /* 4) Single row output with two CSVs (LOB-safe) */
  SELECT
    net_guid_csv = COALESCE(
      (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST('''' + CAST(c.guid AS nvarchar(36)) + '''' AS nvarchar(MAX)), ',')
              WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.created)
       FROM Cands c
       JOIN OK_NET n ON n.guid = c.guid),
      N''
    ),
    alt_guid_csv = COALESCE(
      (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST('''' + CAST(c.guid AS nvarchar(36)) + '''' AS nvarchar(MAX)), ',')
              WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.created)
       FROM Cands c
       JOIN OK_ALT a ON a.guid = c.guid),
      N''
    );
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_700_rebuild_priors_capped
  @days_back INT = 90,
  @max_per_key INT = 200
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#priors_new') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #priors_new;

  ;WITH H AS (
      SELECT
        ct.product,
        ct.signal,
        dbo.fn_700_choose_bucket(ct.product, ct.entry_price) AS entry_bucket,
        dbo.fn_700_time_bin(ct.created) AS time_bin,
        COALESCE(ct.alt_net_return, ct.net_return, 0.0) AS pnl,
        ct.last_update,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY ct.product, ct.signal,
                       dbo.fn_700_choose_bucket(ct.product, ct.entry_price),
                       dbo.fn_700_time_bin(ct.created)
          ORDER BY ct.last_update DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM dbo.vw_700_closed_trades ct
      WHERE ct.last_update >= DATEADD(DAY, -@days_back, SYSDATETIME())
  )
  SELECT
      product,
      signal,
      entry_bucket,
      time_bin,
      CAST(-1 AS SMALLINT) AS session_key,
      COUNT(*) AS prior_count,
      SUM(CASE WHEN pnl > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_win_sum,
      SUM(pnl) AS prior_alt_sum
  INTO #priors_new
  FROM H
  WHERE rn <= @max_per_key
  GROUP BY product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin;

  BEGIN TRAN;
    DELETE FROM dbo.tbl_700_priors;
    INSERT dbo.tbl_700_priors (product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, session, prior_count, prior_win_sum, prior_alt_sum)
    SELECT product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin, NULL, prior_count, prior_win_sum, prior_alt_sum
    FROM #priors_new;
  COMMIT;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_700_recompute_bucket_boundaries
  @N INT = 20   -- number of buckets per product (=> N-1 cutpoints)
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  SET XACT_ABORT ON;

  IF @N < 2
  BEGIN
    THROW 51010, 'N must be >= 2', 1;
  END;

  BEGIN TRAN;

    -- Clear current boundaries
    DELETE FROM dbo.tbl_700_bucket_boundaries;

    -- Derive new boundaries: N tiles per product -> store first row of tiles 2..N as cutpoints
    ;WITH base AS (
        SELECT
          v.product,
          TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,10), v.entry_price) AS px
        FROM dbo.vw_700_closed_trades v
        WHERE v.entry_price IS NOT NULL
      ),
      tiled AS (
        SELECT
          b.product,
          b.px,
          NTILE(@N) OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.px) AS tile
        FROM base b
      ),
      cuts AS (
        SELECT
          t.product,
          t.tile - 1 AS bucket_index,         -- 1..N-1
          MIN(t.px) AS cut_value
        FROM tiled t
        WHERE t.tile >= 2
        GROUP BY t.product, t.tile
      )
    INSERT INTO dbo.tbl_700_bucket_boundaries(product, bucket_index, cut_value, computed_at)
    SELECT c.product, c.bucket_index, c.cut_value, SYSUTCDATETIME()
    FROM cuts c
    WHERE c.cut_value IS NOT NULL;

  COMMIT;
END
