CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_ArchiveKeyDataTables]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0. Common archive gates
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @BatchSize   INT  = 1000;
    DECLARE @ArchiveDate DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @Yesterday   DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @ArchiveDate);
    DECLARE @RowCount    INT  = 1;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Archive combined_trades_closed
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Starting archival for combined_trades_closed...';
    SET @RowCount = 1;
    WHILE @RowCount > 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        WITH RecordsToArchive AS (
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
            FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed
            WHERE created < @ArchiveDate
            ORDER BY created
        )
        DELETE FROM RecordsToArchive
        OUTPUT
            DELETED.guid,
            DELETED.model,
            DELETED.product,
            DELETED.signal,
            DELETED.created,
            DELETED.last_update,
            DELETED.entry_price,
            DELETED.latest_price,
            DELETED.net_return,
            DELETED.alt_net_return
        INTO dbo.combined_trades_closed_arc
        (
            guid,
            model,
            product,
            signal,
            created,
            last_update,
            entry_price,
            latest_price,
            net_return,
            alt_net_return
        );

        SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END;
    PRINT 'Finished archival for combined_trades_closed.';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Archive TradeSnapshotLog
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Starting archival for TradeSnapshotLog...';
    SET @RowCount = 1;
    WHILE @RowCount > 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        WITH RecordsToArchive AS (
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
            FROM dbo.TradeSnapshotLog
            WHERE SnapshotTimestamp < @ArchiveDate
            ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp
        )
        DELETE FROM RecordsToArchive
        OUTPUT
            DELETED.[SnapshotTimestamp],
            DELETED.[Product],
            DELETED.[PositiveBuyOpen],
            DELETED.[PositiveSellOpen],
            DELETED.[PositiveSellOpen_val],
            DELETED.[BlockLatestPrice],
            DELETED.[BuySellIndex],
            DELETED.[tradezone],
            DELETED.[tradepoint],
            DELETED.[current_datetime],
            DELETED.[buy_count],
            DELETED.[sell_count],
            DELETED.[buy_sell_diff],
            DELETED.[bid],
            DELETED.[ask],
            DELETED.[LoggedAt]
        INTO dbo.TradeSnapshotLog_arc
        (
            [SnapshotTimestamp],
            [Product],
            [PositiveBuyOpen],
            [PositiveSellOpen],
            [PositiveSellOpen_val],
            [BlockLatestPrice],
            [BuySellIndex],
            [tradezone],
            [tradepoint],
            [current_datetime],
            [buy_count],
            [sell_count],
            [buy_sell_diff],
            [bid],
            [ask],
            [LoggedAt]
        );
        SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END;
    PRINT 'Finished archival for TradeSnapshotLog.';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Archive TradeSummaryLog
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Starting archival for TradeSummaryLog...';
    SET @RowCount = 1;
    WHILE @RowCount > 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        WITH RecordsToArchive AS (
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
            FROM dbo.TradeSummaryLog
            WHERE CurrentDateTime < @ArchiveDate
            ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
        )
        DELETE FROM RecordsToArchive
        OUTPUT
            DELETED.[CurrentDateTime],
            DELETED.[signal],
            DELETED.[Opened],
            DELETED.[Closed],
            DELETED.[positive],
            DELETED.[age_label],
            DELETED.[current_prices],
            DELETED.[positive_open],
            DELETED.[product]
        INTO dbo.TradeSummaryLog_arc
        (
            [CurrentDateTime],
            [signal],
            [Opened],
            [Closed],
            [positive],
            [age_label],
            [current_prices],
            [positive_open],
            [product]
        );
        SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END;
    PRINT 'Finished archival for TradeSummaryLog.';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. Purge combined_trades_open (older than yesterday, no archive)
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Purging old rows from combined_trades_open...';
    DELETE FROM dbo.combined_trades_open
    WHERE created < @Yesterday;
    PRINT 'Purge of combined_trades_open complete.';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Archive tbl_model_signal_net -> tbl_model_signal_net_arc
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Starting archival for tbl_model_signal_net...';
    SET @RowCount = 1;
    WHILE @RowCount > 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        WITH RecordsToArchive AS (
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
            FROM dbo.tbl_model_signal_net
            WHERE update_time < @ArchiveDate
            ORDER BY update_time
        )
        DELETE FROM RecordsToArchive
        OUTPUT
            DELETED.update_time,
            DELETED.product,
            DELETED.model,
            DELETED.signal,
            DELETED.net_return_sum,
            DELETED.alt_net_return_sum
        INTO dbo.tbl_model_signal_net_arc
        (
            update_time,
            product,
            model,
            signal,
            net_return_sum,
            alt_net_return_sum
        );
        SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END;
    PRINT 'Finished archival for tbl_model_signal_net.';

    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. Archive tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr -> tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr_arc
    --     (Same criteria/pattern as section 5)
    -----------------------------------------------------------------
    PRINT 'Starting archival for tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr...';
    SET @RowCount = 1;
    WHILE @RowCount > 0
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        WITH RecordsToArchive AS (
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
            FROM dbo.tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr
            WHERE update_time < @ArchiveDate
            ORDER BY update_time
        )
        DELETE FROM RecordsToArchive
        OUTPUT
            DELETED.update_time,
            DELETED.product,
            DELETED.model,
            DELETED.signal,
            DELETED.net_return_sum,
            DELETED.alt_net_return_sum
        INTO dbo.tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr_arc
        (
            update_time,
            product,
            model,
            signal,
            net_return_sum,
            alt_net_return_sum
        );
        SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END;
    PRINT 'Finished archival for tbl_model_signal_net_Xhr.';

END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.usp_ep051_refresh_export_cache
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @run_id bigint, @started datetime2 = sysutcdatetime();
    INSERT INTO dbo.ep051_export_cache_run_log(started_at, status) VALUES (@started, 'running');
    SET @run_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

    BEGIN TRY
        -- Mirrors repository.py AGGREGATE_SQL with no date filter (matches
        -- export_snapshot.py's unfiltered local_strategies(settings) call).
        WITH universe AS (
            SELECT CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END strategy_id,
                   MAX(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(strategy_name)),'')) descriptive_name
            FROM dbo.product_forex
            WHERE model LIKE 'DNA[_]%'
            GROUP BY CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END
        ), universe_products AS (
            SELECT strategy_id, STRING_AGG(product, ', ') product_name
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END strategy_id, product
                FROM dbo.product_forex WHERE model LIKE 'DNA[_]%' AND product IS NOT NULL
            ) source_products
            GROUP BY strategy_id
        ), canonical AS (
            SELECT CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END strategy_id,
                   CAST(net_return AS float) net_return, created, COALESCE(g_close_time,last_update,created) closed_at
            FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE model_ix LIKE 'DNA[_]%' AND net_return IS NOT NULL
        ), evidence AS (
            SELECT strategy_id, COUNT_BIG(*) total_trades,
                SUM(CASE WHEN net_return>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wins,
                SUM(CASE WHEN net_return<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) losses,
                SUM(CASE WHEN net_return=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) breakevens,
                SUM(net_return) total_net_return,
                SUM(CASE WHEN net_return>0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) gross_profit,
                ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN net_return<0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END)) gross_loss,
                MIN(created) evidence_start, MAX(closed_at) evidence_end
            FROM canonical GROUP BY strategy_id
        )
        SELECT
            universe.strategy_id, universe.descriptive_name, universe_products.product_name,
            COALESCE(evidence.total_trades,0) total_trades, COALESCE(evidence.wins,0) wins,
            COALESCE(evidence.losses,0) losses, COALESCE(evidence.breakevens,0) breakevens,
            CAST(COALESCE(evidence.total_net_return,0) AS decimal(28,8)) total_net_return,
            CAST(COALESCE(CAST(evidence.wins AS decimal(28,10))/NULLIF(evidence.total_trades,0),0) AS decimal(18,10)) win_rate,
            CAST(evidence.gross_profit/NULLIF(evidence.gross_loss,0) AS decimal(18,10)) profit_factor,
            CAST(NULL AS decimal(28,8)) max_drawdown_money,
            evidence.evidence_start, evidence.evidence_end,
            sysutcdatetime() refreshed_at
        INTO #strategy_staging
        FROM universe
        LEFT JOIN universe_products ON universe_products.strategy_id=universe.strategy_id
        LEFT JOIN evidence ON evidence.strategy_id=universe.strategy_id;

        -- Mirrors repository.py local_equity_curves() (MAX_PROFILE_POINTS=1000 per strategy).
        WITH ranked_trades AS (
            SELECT
                CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END strategy_id,
                COALESCE(g_close_time,last_update,created) closed_at, created opened_at, created, guid,
                CAST(net_return AS float) net_return,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                    PARTITION BY CASE WHEN RIGHT(model,2) IN ('_B','_S') THEN LEFT(model,LEN(model)-2) ELSE model END
                    ORDER BY COALESCE(g_close_time,last_update,created) DESC, created DESC, guid DESC) reverse_number
            FROM dbo.combined_trades_closed WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE model_ix LIKE 'DNA[_]%' AND net_return IS NOT NULL
        ), trades AS (
            SELECT strategy_id, closed_at, opened_at, created, guid, net_return
            FROM ranked_trades WHERE reverse_number <= 1000
        ), equity AS (
            SELECT strategy_id, closed_at, opened_at, guid, net_return,
                SUM(net_return) OVER(PARTITION BY strategy_id ORDER BY closed_at, created, guid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) equity
            FROM trades
        ), curve AS (
            SELECT strategy_id, closed_at, opened_at, guid, net_return, equity,
                equity - CASE WHEN MAX(equity) OVER(PARTITION BY strategy_id ORDER BY closed_at, guid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) > 0
                              THEN MAX(equity) OVER(PARTITION BY strategy_id ORDER BY closed_at, guid ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) ELSE 0 END drawdown,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY strategy_id ORDER BY closed_at, guid) trade_number
            FROM equity
        )
        SELECT strategy_id, trade_number, opened_at, closed_at, net_return, equity, drawdown,
               sysutcdatetime() refreshed_at
        INTO #equity_staging
        FROM curve;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
            TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.ep051_export_strategy_summary;
            INSERT INTO dbo.ep051_export_strategy_summary
                (strategy_id, descriptive_name, product_name, total_trades, wins, losses, breakevens,
                 total_net_return, win_rate, profit_factor, max_drawdown_money, evidence_start, evidence_end, refreshed_at)
            SELECT strategy_id, descriptive_name, product_name, total_trades, wins, losses, breakevens,
                   total_net_return, win_rate, profit_factor, max_drawdown_money, evidence_start, evidence_end, refreshed_at
            FROM #strategy_staging;

            TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.ep051_export_equity_curve;
            INSERT INTO dbo.ep051_export_equity_curve
                (strategy_id, trade_number, opened_at, closed_at, net_return, equity, drawdown, refreshed_at)
            SELECT strategy_id, trade_number, opened_at, closed_at, net_return, equity, drawdown, refreshed_at
            FROM #equity_staging;
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        UPDATE dbo.ep051_export_cache_run_log
        SET completed_at = sysutcdatetime(),
            strategy_rows = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ep051_export_strategy_summary),
            equity_curve_rows = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ep051_export_equity_curve),
            status = 'success'
        WHERE run_id = @run_id;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        UPDATE dbo.ep051_export_cache_run_log
        SET completed_at = sysutcdatetime(), status = 'failed', error_message = ERROR_MESSAGE()
        WHERE run_id = @run_id;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE usp_GetTopPerformingModelTradeSummaryByDate
    -- The date for which to generate the summary. If NULL, it will use the latest closing date available.
    @SummaryDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @SummaryDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        -- Use last_update to find the most recent closing date
        SELECT @SummaryDate = MAX(CAST(last_update AS DATE))
        FROM vwCombined_trades_closed;
    END;

    -- CTE 1: Aggregate data based on the closing date (last_update)
    WITH ModelPerformance AS (
        SELECT
            -- Group by the closing date
            CAST(last_update AS DATE) AS TradeDate,
            model,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) AS Sum_Buy_NetReturn,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Count_Buy_Trades,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) AS Sum_Sell_NetReturn,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Count_Sell_Trades,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy' THEN alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS Sum_Buy_AltNetReturn,
            SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS Sum_Sell_AltNetReturn
        FROM vwCombined_trades_closed
        -- Filter by the closing date
        WHERE CAST(last_update AS DATE) = @SummaryDate
        GROUP BY CAST(last_update AS DATE), model
    ),
    -- CTE 2: Calculate profit-to-trade ratios
    ModelRatios AS (
        SELECT
            TradeDate,
            model,
            Count_Buy_Trades,
            Count_Sell_Trades,
            CASE WHEN Count_Buy_Trades > 0 THEN CAST(Sum_Buy_NetReturn AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) / Count_Buy_Trades ELSE 0.0 END AS Buy_NetReturn_Ratio,
            CASE WHEN Count_Sell_Trades > 0 THEN CAST(Sum_Sell_NetReturn AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) / Count_Sell_Trades ELSE 0.0 END AS Sell_NetReturn_Ratio,
            CASE WHEN Count_Buy_Trades > 0 THEN CAST(Sum_Buy_AltNetReturn AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) / Count_Buy_Trades ELSE 0.0 END AS Buy_AltNetReturn_Ratio,
            CASE WHEN Count_Sell_Trades > 0 THEN CAST(Sum_Sell_AltNetReturn AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) / Count_Sell_Trades ELSE 0.0 END AS Sell_AltNetReturn_Ratio
        FROM ModelPerformance
    )
    -- Final SELECT to find the top PROFITABLE model for each category.
    -- Each part of the UNION now filters for a positive ratio BEFORE ranking.

    -- Best Buy Net Return
    SELECT
        'Best Buy Net Return' AS Category,
        TradeDate AS SummaryDate,
        model,
        Buy_NetReturn_Ratio AS ProfitToTradeRatio,
        Count_Buy_Trades AS TotalClosedTrades
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Buy_NetReturn_Ratio DESC) as rn
        FROM ModelRatios
        WHERE Buy_NetReturn_Ratio > 0  -- Only consider profitable models
    ) AS RankedData
    WHERE rn = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Best Sell Net Return
    SELECT
        'Best Sell Net Return' AS Category,
        TradeDate AS SummaryDate,
        model,
        Sell_NetReturn_Ratio AS ProfitToTradeRatio,
        Count_Sell_Trades AS TotalClosedTrades
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Sell_NetReturn_Ratio DESC) as rn
        FROM ModelRatios
        WHERE Sell_NetReturn_Ratio > 0 -- Only consider profitable models
    ) AS RankedData
    WHERE rn = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Best Buy Alt Net Return
    SELECT
        'Best Buy Alt Net Return' AS Category,
        TradeDate AS SummaryDate,
        model,
        Buy_AltNetReturn_Ratio AS ProfitToTradeRatio,
        Count_Buy_Trades AS TotalClosedTrades
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Buy_AltNetReturn_Ratio DESC) as rn
        FROM ModelRatios
        WHERE Buy_AltNetReturn_Ratio > 0 -- Only consider profitable models
    ) AS RankedData
    WHERE rn = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Best Sell Alt Net Return
    SELECT
        'Best Sell Alt Net Return' AS Category,
        TradeDate AS SummaryDate,
        model,
        Sell_AltNetReturn_Ratio AS ProfitToTradeRatio,
        Count_Sell_Trades AS TotalClosedTrades
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Sell_AltNetReturn_Ratio DESC) as rn
        FROM ModelRatios
        WHERE Sell_AltNetReturn_Ratio > 0 -- Only consider profitable models
    ) AS RankedData
    WHERE rn = 1

    ORDER BY Category;

END
